Simulation has been carried out in MATLAB<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Virtual GPS Guided Autonomous Wheel Chair or Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: To make locomotion easier and possible for human beings of all age group, an autonomous vehicle is designed. This vehicle is able to overcome obstacles in its path and reach the destination. In this paper, use of ARM processor, PC, Zigbee module is used to make the system driverless. The designed vehicle is a four wheeler and can carry one person at a time.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control of Security Constrained Deregulated Power System Using Crow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, load frequency control (LFC) of nonlinear multi-area interconnected deregulated power system (DPS) is presented. To obtain realistic design, the DPS is modelled with reheat, non-reheat and hydro generators considering nonlinear security constraints - generation rate constraint (GRC), governor dead band (GDB), time delay (TD) and different system parameter values. A unique objective function is formulated by taking into account of the right combination of transient and steady state performance specifications with appropriate weighting coefficients. In this work, recently developed crow search algorithm (CSA) is used to obtain the optimal PID control gains for optimal steady state and transient performances. The performance of the proposed CSA based control system is compared with real codded GA (RGA) and enhanced PSO (EPSO) based control strategy. The proposed methodology gives best results in all cases.

articleTitle: Field Oriented Control of Surface Mount Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine with Non Linear Observer for Continuous Rotor Position Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Vector control of Permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) is executed with the knowledge of rotor angle for stator commutation. The paper proposes a method to utilize the feature of obtaining continuous rotor position from the Ortega non-linear observer to be used in a Field oriented control of PMSM. In addition, the speed information is necessary for current decoupling in Field oriented control. The sensorless algorithm implemented also uses a Phase lock loop (PLL) to estimate the speed, instead of numerical differentiation. Unlike the passivity observers which can give only rotor positions, the implemented algorithm estimates continuous rotor angle and also the speed thus completely eliminating the need of encoders. The implemented observer algorithm is tested with a Field oriented controller for a 0.3 kW surface mount PMSM and tested in MATLAB/Simulink for its speed tracking capability under various operating conditions. The implemented control algorithm exhibited good tracking accuracies under almost all the operating conditions.

articleTitle: Smart Underwriting System: An Intelligent Decision Support System for Insurance Approval & Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Over the past years, insurance industry poses many challenges, one of them is maintaining the data either in legacy systems or in paper files for underwriting transaction. Most of the insurance companies are automating their data collection process. Traditionally, information of the client (such as personal details, medical records etc.) who needs insurance is sent to the underwriter through an email and after proper analysis, underwriter sends the quickQuote back to the agent based on his intuition and experience. Generally, quickQuote consists of insurance approval conditions and insurance plan name. Due to enormous amount of diseases and medicines, complexity in underwriting process has been increased. In a nutshell, an improved and optimized way of underwriting process is required. Introducing Artificial Intelligence can help to transform the traditional underwriting process to smart one. Usually data given to the underwriter is in unstructured format. Using Natural Language Processing and by training numerous statistical machine learning classifiers over the unstructured texts, important features were extracted out from unstructured emails. Main challenge is to exploit the information embedded in emails using automated tools, because of noisiness, uncleaned and unstructured data. Based on the features extracted, a model was trained and tested for unseen mails to get the proper insurance plan name and advice. This data was drafted to a template and sent back to the agent through an automated email reply. Main Objective of the project is to handle dynamic situations efficiently and to automate the underwriting task.

articleTitle: A Parametric Study of Partitioning and Density Based Clustering Techniques for Boxplot Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The Boxplot uses five point summary of data to display information. K-Means and DBSCAN clustering methods are used to improve the Boxplots. Both the above methods have parameters which affect the clusters formed by the algorithms. The results obtained by varying these parameters i.e. K in K-Means and Eps and MinPts in DBSCAN clustering methods are studied in this paper. The Boxplots obtained by varying the above mentioned parameters are plotted and the effects of varying the parameters have been studied. A comparative figure of traditional Boxplot and Boxplots generated using K-Means and DBSCAN clustering has also been plotted. The comparisons and differences have been discussed between the above mentioned Boxplots.

articleTitle: Adoption of SVPWM Technique to CSI and VSI
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The main objective of the paper includes implementation and control of converters using Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) technique and the SVPWM pulses are given to the converters and THD analysis at different specifications of converters is carried out. This paper is focuses on step by step development of the SVPWM Model, and applying it to Voltage Source inverter (VSI) and Current Source inverters (CSI) and comparing them on various parameters. The model of a three-phase VSI and CSI are discussed based on space vector theory. The Simulation results are obtained by using MATLAB/Simulink for effectiveness of the study.

articleTitle: Content Based Image Retrieval Using Improved Gabor Wavelet Transform and Linear Discriminant Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Content based image retrieval (CBIR) system performs an important role in the retrieval of desired images from larger image database efficiently. It finds applications in all areas including government, hospitals, surveillance, architecture, journalism and many more. Improvement in the precision and recall of the CBIR systems is desired and challenging problem for all the researchers. CBIR system using collective color and texture feature extraction with linear discriminant analysis is proposed in this paper. Gabor filter and color histogram has proved to be very effective in describing visual content of the image. Images in database are described using concatenated feature vectors of texture and color. The computational complexity of obtaining the texture features through Gabor wavelet transform has been improved through down sampling of the query and database images. Linear discriminant analysis is a powerful and popular method to extract the exact information for retrieving the images from the database. It also assist in increasing recognition rate of the content based image retrieval even despite the fact that training set belongs to unsupervised nature. thus the combined features of texture and color obtained through Gabor wavelet transform and color histogram respectively with linear discriminant analysis assist in reducing retrieval time.

articleTitle: Comparision of Interline Power Flow Controller with Line Reactor and SSSC in a 400kV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The effective series power flow control in a transmission line through conventional method are generally implemented with series line reactors in power grids, as these reactors are economical in terms of project cost and easy to install. The conventional reactors can control the power flow in the event of a sudden increase in load current, however the voltage profile of the respective bus is deteriorating. Consequently series Flexible AC transmission systems (FACTS) devices have been utilized to improvise power flow while maintaining the voltage profile at bus and reducing line losses. Among the series FACTS devices the most predominant series FACTS device, is the Interline power flow controller (IPFC). This paper investigates the effectiveness of IPFC in controlling the power flow and while maintaining the voltage profile in a test power system. Furthermore the results are compared with a Static synchronous series compensator (SSSC) compensator. This study provides insight to the industrialists in utilizing FACTS devices in grid networks.

articleTitle: Vehicle Tracking and Accident Notification System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Nowadays many accidents occur on roads due to increase in traffic or due to rash driving on highways. In many situations, the family members or the ambulance authorities are not informed in time. This results in a delay of medical aid to the victim, which may at times prove to be fatal. The main objective of our paper `Vehicle Tracking and Accident Notification System' is to avoid such mishaps. The vehicle tracking system provides security to all vehicles by tracking them continuously whereas accident notification rescues people who have met with an accident by detecting accidents with the help of various sensors. Both the systems, provide improved security to all vehicles and prevent death due to untimely treatment by the implementation of Global Positioning System (GPS), General Packet Radio Service (GPRS), Global System for Mobile (GSM) technologies.

articleTitle: Uneven Illumination Compensation for Unconstrained Face Recognition Using LBP
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Face recognition results are degraded when the test image is having nonuniform illumination variations. Due to the lighting variations, different expressions and occlusions the facial appearance of the face changes dramatically such that recognition by the methods is quite a difficult task. Out of which the problems due to illumination variations such as shadows, under lighting, over lighting in the face are the crucial problems which are to be overcome to achieve the satisfactory results for an automatic face recognition system. In this paper, we propose an efficient illumination compensation method based on frequency analysis and multi-resolution analysis. The effect of uneven lighting variations of the test image is efficiently and effectively removed by applying the LBP image to modify the magnitude information in the frequency domain. The magnitudes of the LBP image compensate the distorted magnitudes of the original image, caused by the light variations, as well as add some structural information to the restored image. To examine the efficacy of our developed method, histogram equalization based normalization and Fourier based normalization methods are compared with the proposed method. An extensive simulation study has been carried out to measure the effectiveness of our proposed method on the images containing extreme illumination variations. For this purpose, we have used the Extended Yale-B face database. From the results, it is found that our proposed method outperforms other methods and also it works better for extremely poor illuminated images.

articleTitle: Gesture Controlled Prosthetic Arm with Sensation Sensors
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The importance of a Prosthetic Arm can only be realized by a handicapped person. But these arms are not easy to make., commonly don't have multiple degree of freedom., complex to use and costly. That's why this project intended to make a prosthetic arm that can be made easily with degree of freedom close to real hand., user friendly and cost efficient. Here., Degree of Freedom is the number of independent parameters in a mechanical system. It defines the freedom of movement in system. The chassis of the hand was made by 3D printing technology which removed complexity of production. Chassis was made mimicking an actual hand to give maximum degree of freedom. The hand can be operated by flex sensor which can mimic the movement of other functional hand. The sensor will send data to the servo motors that will be moving the fingers of the prosthetic arm as like as the functional arm., which makes it user friendly. Again., an LM35 sensor was used in the hand which can send heat sensation feedback to a Peltier plate that makes user to feel the heat sensation like an actual arm. The whole project was made with locally and commonly available materials which made successfully a cost efficient one.

articleTitle: Exploration of Nonlinear Behaviour in a V2 Controlled Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The paper deals with the nonlinear phenomena in a V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> controlled buck converter where the output ripple voltage has been considered as a control variable. The mathematical model has been developed in continuous conduction mode (CCM) as well as in discontinuous conduction mode (DCM). The paper also attempts in analyzing the bifurcation behaviour by varying the parameters of the circuit in different ways.

articleTitle: Robust Encryption of Uncompressed Videos with a Selective Frame Scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The wide use of video multimedia applications has made it important to improve the security of video information for streaming it over communication links. In this case cryptography techniques are necessary and the security of video information becomes essential. Existing video encryption scheme address this issue by using chaotic map or standard private key systems [1]. In this paper” we propose an encryption scheme which uses a computationally simple technique like “Simplified Data Encryption Standard” (SDES) along with a novel frame selection scheme. The use of frame selection mechanism makes the technique easy to implement. Robustness is achieved with the help of “RSA” encryption on user key parameters. The proposed scheme is evaluated using unique feature such as “Unified average changing intensity” (UACI) and “Number of Pixel Change Rate” (NPCR). We tested proposed scheme on videos containing different videos of “visual correlation” and we find that proposed scheme works reasonably well irrespective of level of “visual correlation”.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Based Indoor Air Quality Improving System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Efficient and cost effective technology based solutions helps to achieve prosperity of people on the planet. Good health of the people depend on good air quality. In this paper we propose, Internet of things (IOT) based system to purify air quality using indoor plants. Air purification ability of Sansevieria trifasciata and Chlorophytum comosum plant is analyzed in closed environment. These plants are re-silent and requires very less maintenance. Use of these indoor plants in a office, home purifies air quality. The proposed Internet of Things based study, suggests an inexpensive and green way of having healthier lifestyle. Experimental results of this study concludes that, Sansevieria trifasciata and Chlorophytum comosum plants are effective and very low cost solution to purify indoor air quality.

articleTitle: An Android Application Controlled Video Surveillance Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper emphasizes on developing a surveillance vehicle which can be used to monitor inaccessible or hazardous areas. In this project, a vehicle is controlled and monitored using a tailored Android Application. The user can give directional inputs to the vehicle through a mobile application and can monitor its surroundings via video streaming. Arduino Uno, Crowtail Wi-Fi module and a Motor Base shield is used at the heart of the system. Wi-Fi module is used to establish a connection between the mobile application and the vehicle. The Wi-Fi module receives the directional inputs from the user and delivers it serially to Arduino. This module is also responsible for transmitting the video signal to an Android device. In addition to live video streaming, a GPS module is added on the vehicle for location tracking. The co-ordinates of the vehicle are sent to the android app using ESP8266 Wifi module. The location of the vehicle and the user is then displayed on the application using Google maps API.

articleTitle: Gender, Makeup, Age and Illumination Prediction from Faces Using Ensemble Modeling
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Gender, makeup, age and illumination classification has become one of the major task and these tasks has become more powerful in real time applications. Still, the performance of existing method is lacking when compared in optimization. In this research paper we have been applied various machine learning models to get the results more optimized. We try to developed ensemble techniques for sturdy age classification ranges and these ranges are classified into four categories that are child, young, middle and old. Similarly Gender classification ranges are divided into male and female and Makeup classification ranges are divided into partial makeup and over makeup and also illumination classification ranges are divided into bad, medium and high categories.

articleTitle: Product Rank Based Search Engine for E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In today's world, e-commerce is the strongest and the fastest growing platform. People inclined to buy products from websites now and then. Up to the present time price comparisons of the same product on different websites are available but now, moving a step ahead, our proposed system tends to serve as a smart web spider for all e-commerce websites, which crawls the whole website for you and find out the cheapest yet best quality products of your choice in real time. Moreover, this assures the union of all e-commerce website in form of one rigorously filtered system. It is also capable of making good recommendations as per customer's requirement and serves as an active agent in the system. This product can also prove beneficial for e-commerce companies because it will be able to track down dead pages, Seller's wrongly entered price or any kind of glitches/errors/fraudulent activities on their websites in real time.

articleTitle: Application of WSN in UAV
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) has a variety of applications such as Habitat monitoring, Weather forecasting, Military Applications and so on. Due to technology advancement, it is good to integrate WSN with various other emerging technologies like Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). We Team Dronix from Panimalar Institute of Technology, Chennai, India have developed a cost effective UAV solutions for three such applications in the field of Air Pollution Monitoring, Forest Fire Monitoring and Inventory Management. Even though regulatory issues are there for UA V, now the people understood that to regulate is better than a ban.

articleTitle: Development of Platform Independent Hand Gesture Controlled Wearable Mouse
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) is an ever growing and a commercially developing technology. Smart devices and wearable electronics are becoming very popular, but as of now, there is no available alternative to practically replace the conventional mouse. This paper presents a design for a fully operational hand-gesture controlled wearable mouse. It is easy to wear and remove that makes it ideal for daily use. It is a platform-independent design using Human Interface Device (HID) technology. It is a simple plug and play type device without the need for a special driver and other software support. From motion detection point of view, what are the differences between accelerometer and gyroscope are also clearly explained here with help of graphs and results. The suitable sensor has been used to detect hand gestures and accordingly change the position of the mouse pointer.

articleTitle: Noninvasive Blood Glucose Prediction from Photoplethysmogram Using Relevance Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus is one of the predominant threats., hence monitoring the glucose levels is crucial. Clinically., it is measured using invasive blood tests. However., using photoplethysmogram (PPG) signals it is possible to find the blood glucose values., non-invasively. In this paper., PPG signals are used to predict BGL using relevance vector machine (RVM)., a supervised learning algorithm. Additionally., random forest (RF) is used to predict BGL for comparison. The BGLs obtained are validated using Cohen kappa statistics. RVM performs better with the kappa score of 0.955 with a computation time of 3.720 seconds; whereas., the kappa score of RF is 0.759 with computation time 1.94 minutes.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Current Harmonics Using Shunt Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Use of power electronic devices and semiconductor technology has increased the uses of nonlinear loads. Arc furnace adjustable speed drives, converters, PWM modulated drives are some of the nonlinear loads that play major role in declining the power quality by injecting the harmonics in power supply. This paper represents a control strategy for a 3-ph shunt active power filter is proposed. SAPF acts as VSI in parallel with the load to mitigate the current harmonics by injecting equal and opposite harmonic contents at the point of common coupling. Simulation of SAPF implemented on generalized instantaneous power theory is done with the MATLAB SIMULINK. The simulation shows outputs and FFT analysis of with filter and without filter.

articleTitle: Troll-Detection Systems Limitations of Troll Detection Systems and AI/ML Anti-Trolling Solution
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Trolling is a modern-day vice which has manifested itself in the burgeoning virtual world. As bullying shifts from playgrounds to social media, the need of the hour is having anti-trolling softwares in place to combat this malpractice. Many internet companies have taken steps in this direction by creating softwares or applications that can prevent trolling but none have been completely successful. The word anti-trolling has existed as a concept for a long time. It is necessary to make it a concrete reality. Most of the softwares identify abusive words and simply block them but trolls have found ways to circumvent this obstacle by using clever ways. This paper explores the currently existing “Anti-trolling systems”, their methodologies and technological challenges. In particular, we consider machine learning and existing expert systems that detect and prevent trolls. The paper concludes with a discussion of the issues faced by this technology, the current functioning and a few suggestions along with a modified architecture and the vision of a trolling-free internet.

articleTitle: Secondary User Channel Selection in Cognitive Radio Network Using Adaptive Method
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: While selecting a free time slot of a licensed user, secondary users (SU) have to decide based on some parameters including primary user service type, secondary user service type, channel outage probability, delay of channel, transmission rate of channel etc. Proper channel utilization and quality of service (QoS) largely depend on properly selecting channel from available channels. In our work, we have focused on these things. We have proposed distributed mutual exclusion (DME) and Bayesian approach here. Using Bayesian approach, channel utilization can be calculated and based on channel utilization, channel is chosen for secondary usage. Simulation result shows that, lower outage probability and higher signal to noise ratio are achievable rather than blindly selecting a channel for secondary usage.

articleTitle: Differential Microstrip Antenna with Side Wall Patch for RF Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a differential microstrip antenna with side wall patch is introduced for RF energy harvesting. The antenna ground and patch are shorted with perfect electric conductor (PEC) for obtaining multiband. The side wall patches are used for adjusting the resonating frequencies to cover WLAN (IEEE 802.11) and WiMAX (IEEE 802.16). The top microstrip antenna is electromagnetically coupled to bottom microstrip antenna to enhance the bandwidth and improve the gain. The proposed differential microstrip antenna is simulated to obtain the functional characteristics like gain, radiation pattern, VSWR and return loss. Also, it is observed that this antenna can harvest energy from ten different bands of electromagnetic spectrum.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Evaluation of Hybrid Full Adder for Extensive PDP Reduction
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Modern VLSI techniques focus greatly on High Speed Propagation and Low Power Consumption. In this research paper, we present a hybrid 1-bit full adder design which employs both static CMOS logic and Swing Restoring Pass Transistor Logic (SRPL). We have compared our work against other state of art designs, for power consumption, speed and area constraints. We designed all the full-adders in Mentor Graphics Tanner 0.18μm CMOS technology. At 1.8V power supply, the average power consumed by our design is 3.69μW, at 100MHz and the propagation delay 0.21ns. Beyond all doubts, our design not only reduces the complexity but also offers multiple fold reduction in PDP.

articleTitle: Retrieving Real Time Data Through IOT Devices and Storing Securely on Cloud Using Li-Fi
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Internet of things is an accumulation of physical objects which are able to send information over the network. Nowaday, an association utilizes IoT devices to gather real time and continuous data from sensors. This information can be utilized to enhance the customer satisfaction and to make better business decisions. The cloud has various advantages over on-premises storage for storing IoT information. But there are apprehensions with using the cloud for IoT data storage. The real one is security. To exchange the information over the cloud IoT devices utilizes WiFi technology. However, it has a few limits that confine the potential outcomes of the Internet of Things. On the off chance that more devices or clients that will be associated with the internet utilizing WiFi, the transfer speed gets separated among the clients hence the outcome will be slower network. Consequently, there is a necessity of a speedier and a solid internet administration to the Internet of Things to be completely operational. This paper shows the strategy which permits exchanging gathered loT information over the cloud safely utilizing LiFi innovation by applying role based access control approaches and the cryptography techniques.

articleTitle: Vehicle Counting Module Design in Small Scale for Traffic Management in Smart City
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Currently, smart city project is running in INDIA for urban development. Under this project, intelligent transportation system (ITS) is the very significant step towards achieving the goal of reducing traffic congestion as well as different traffic monitoring applications, like - parking management, emergency vehicle detection, car speed detection, accidents detection, car counting etc. To achieve intelligent transportation system's goal for traffic monitoring, Image and video processing becomes a significant tool. In this article focus on vehicle counting, or say car counting for available online video (YouTube) using - Frame difference, Edge detection, Euclidean distance methods, Morphology, adaptive thresholding and effective prediction of center position with addition of calculation of change in positions, delta positions and Gaussian blur. To differentiate car as an object with another object, we consider here particular size for car objects or say four-wheelers objects, which are different then pedestrians available on the road, as well as different static objects-like a tree, posters available on road etc. Here simulation results check for Ahmedabad, Chennai, Bangalore, Mumbai traffic related video available with different resolution on YouTube. Also with night traffic conditions. For, Ahmedabad Traffic video, simulation results validate using recall, precision, and F1 parameter.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System for MANET
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET), we cannot predict the clear picture of the topology of a node because of its varying nature. Without notice participation and departure of nodes results in lack of trust relationship between nodes. In such circumstances, there is no guarantee that path between two nodes would be secure or free of malicious nodes. The presence of single malicious node could lead repeatedly compromised node. After providing security to route and data packets still, there is a need for the implementation of defense mechanism that is intrusion detection system(IDS) against compromised nodes. In this paper, we have implemented IDS, which defend against some routing attacks like the black hole and gray hole successfully. After measuring performance we get marginally increased Packet delivery ratio and Throughput.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis and Simulation of Different CMOS Full Adders Using Cadence in 90 nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper analyzes & compares four adders with different logic styles (Conventional, transmission gate, 14 transistors & GDI based technique) for transistor count, power dissipation, delay and power delay product. It is performed in virtuoso platform, using Cadence tool with available GPDK - 90nm kit. The width of NMOS and PMOS is set at 120nm and 240nm respectively. Transmission gate full adder has sheer advantage of high speed but consumes more power. GDI full adder gives reduced voltage swing not being able to pass logic 1 and logic 0 completely showing degraded output. Transmission gate full adder shows better performance in terms of delay (0.417530 ns), whereas 14T full adder shows better performance in terms of all three aspects.

articleTitle: Electronically Pattern Reconfigurable Hexagon Shaped Loop Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Pattern reconfigurable antennas are extremely important in the present-day world of wireless communication systems as they steer their radiation beam in specific directions to overcome interferences & adjust to surroundings. One such microstrip antenna proposed in this research work consists of a hexagon shaped Alford type loop radiator with a tapered ground plane for proper matching, fed by a coaxial connector. It consists of three pin diodes switched by changing bias voltages to achieve beam reconfigurability. The antenna operates in the 2.4GHz band with a 10dB impedance bandwidth from 2.33GHz to 2.58GHz, with rotating beam at angles of 60° covering the entire azimuthal plane. The antenna provides a maximum gain of 3dB with significant beamforming capability. Simulated results are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Multiband Antenna Using FSS
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A low profile and highly selective multi band FSS antenna is proposed. The substrate used is FR4 epoxy with height 1.6mm and relative permittivity 4.4. The design is a u shaped rectangular patch. The feeding used is micro strip line feeding. The resonating frequencies are 0.88GHz, 0.93GHz, 1.04GHz and 1.12GHz. The proposed design has its application in GSM. HFSS software is used to simulate the design.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Trajectory Gatherings Pattern Mining Method Based on R* Tree Index
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Spatio-temporal traj ectory gatherings pattern refers to a group of moving objects getting together and forming durable and stable areas in high density, which is often used to monitor and predict abnormal group events. Yet it is still a challenge to discover the specific gathering pattern effectively and efficiently with the generation of large volume of trajectory data. In the light, we propose a novel improved algorithm based on R* tree index for mining gatherings pattern of spatio-temporal trajectory, in which we consider moving objects' direction property in the trajectory simplify stage and we use R* tree index in the clustering stage to improve the effectiveness and efficiency. The experiment based on the real trajectory dataset demonstrates that the proposed method is superior in efficiency to the existing method and can guarantee the same effectiveness for moving object gatherings pattern mining.

articleTitle: Implementation of Model Predictive Control for Conventional Switched Capacitor Multilevel Inverter to Reduce Input Current Peak and Capacitor Voltage Ripple
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the increase in the use of renewable sources, there has been a significant topological development of multilevel inverters (MLIs). A number of MLI topologies have been developed in recent years which opens significant possibilities for further improving the robustness and efficiency of the inverter systems. Switched Capacitor Multilevel Inverter (SC-MLI) is a novel MLI structure introduced recently which requires a reduced number of power supplies in comparison with the conventional multilevel inverters. In SC-MLI, capacitors are used as alternative dc sources. Further, SCMLI possesses the voltage boosting capability and self-capacitor voltage balancing ability. One of the major limitations of SCMLI is that the input current is discontinuous and has an extremely high peak which may damage the input source and the components associated with it. Hence, the controlling of input current is required. Further, the controlling of output current of inverter, an appropriate control strategy has to be employed. For achieving these, in this paper Model Predictive Control (MPC) strategy has been implemented for basic SC-MLI unit. Extensive simulation study of 5-level SCMLI in MATLAB/Simulink shows that by using MPC, the inverter can produce the voltage levels in such way that the desired load current is achieved. Further, the peak magnitude of input current and capacitor voltage ripple are significantly reduced as compared to open loop control strategy.

articleTitle: Modeling for Optimality in Design of Planetary Ring Gear to Reduce Stress Development a Response Surface Methodology Based Parametric Modelling Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Parametric modeling and optimization is emphasized in this work utilizing response surface methodology for a ring gear, the largest component in a planetary gear mechanism. The purpose of this paper is to disseminate design optimization based information for developing robust transmission system using finite element analysis. The methodology employed for assessing failure in gear components is modeled and optimized to reduce stress development. Analysis based on combination of statistical and mathematical modeling tools is employed for achieving desirable result. The mathematical modeling concepts exemplified for the ring gear can be used for other gear members. This paper serves the purpose of deducing strategic design related decision from design optimization concepts for achieving the best performance characteristics.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dead Nodes to Evaluate Energy Hole in Data Gathering Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Wireless sensor network is rapidly growing technology in military, industry, medical, security and surveillance applications. It is mostly used in unattended hostile environment to detect, track, monitor, collect intruder activity as per various application requirements. Sensor nodes in data gathering wireless sensor networks are battery dependent. Most of the time battery replacement or charging of battery is not feasible in unattended condition so to prolong the network lifetime analysis of dead nodes is necessary. Once the analysis is studied, one can apply optimization techniques to improve lifetime of network. When node closer to sink node drain battery quickly due to heavy traffic load, energy hole problem occurs and whole network causes premature death hence performance highly degraded. In this paper, dead nodes, packet loss, energy consumption of dead nodes are simulated on network simulator using Double Cost based Function Routing(DCFR) and results are compared with Greedy Geographic Routing(GGR).

articleTitle: MPTCP Performance with Various Configurations, Path Failures and Recovery
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Multipath TCP (MPTCP) is ongoing effort to enable simultaneous usage of multiple interfaces or IP addresses for a TCP session. It provides regular TCP to applications and distributes segments across multiple subftows to achieve the desired goal of reliability in the face of failure of a path and goodput equal to the sum of throughput available on all link-layer paths. All of the reported works on the behavioural study of this new extension to TCP focus on the performance of default MPTCP configuration. A broader experimental evaluating MPTCP behaviour under the combinations of four congestion control algorithms, two schedulers, three client-server applications, and the presence or absence of link failure on possible links is reported here. Two important observations are noticed. First, the CUBIC congestion control algorithm is unable to balance traffic evenly across all subflows and demonstrates poor recovery from path failures. Second, iPerf does not utilize MPTCP sequencing and reassembly correctly. Consequently, it shows erratic behaviour in path failure cases and reports throughput incorrectly. iPerf is thus an unsuitable candidate for MPTCP testing. Based on the experiments performed, cURL is found to be one of the best candidates for testing MPTCP.

articleTitle: Dynamic Phasor Modeling of Induction Machine with Standard Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents dynamic phasor (DP) modeling of induction machine with standard parameters. The model can be used for simulation and analysis of the induction machine under balanced as well as unbalanced operating condition. In order to validate the model, DQ-model of induction machine with standard parameters is developed. Both the models are simulated under balanced as well as unbalanced operating conditions. The model gives simulation results which closely match with detailed time domain simulation with conventional DQ-model. It is observed that execution time of DP-model of induction machine is less than DQ-model with same operating parameters.

articleTitle: Denoising of Facial Images Using Non-Negative Matrix Factorization with Sparseness Constraint
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, we have studied denoising of facial images using non-negative matrix factorization with sparseness constraint. We have considered gaussian noise with zero mean and salt-pepper noise for our study. This type of noise partakes during image acquisition and are additive in nature. Here, we have also seen how this algorithm is able to compress the database and the possible areas to use this algorithm. We have validated this algorithm with standard error parameter of relative root mean square error. We also found out that the algorithm is not much affected with noise.

articleTitle: Fire Detection in a Varying Topography Using Landsat-8 for Nainital Region, India
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Forest fires are the most frequent phenomenon during the summer season in India, and especially in the hilly terrains of Uttarakhand forests. Remote sensing sensors such as Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS), Advanced Very High Resolution Radiometer (AVHRR), Advanced Spaceborne Thermal Emission and Reflection Radiometer (ASTER) and Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) with coarse spatial resolution on board different satellites were used to detect the forest fires across the world. Landsat-8 Operational Land Imager (OLI) data has the better spatial resolution (30m) as compared with the MODIS and VIIRS, therefore useful to detect the smaller fires. Nainital district in Uttarakhand state was severely affected by the massive forest fire events occurred during April-May, 2016. The main objective of the study is to identify the potential of Landsat-8 data in detecting the forest fire for varying topographic region like Nainital. Landsat-8 data acquired on 28<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> April 2016 and 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> May 2016 has been used in this study. The results obtained from Landsat-8 data are compared with the MODIS fire products and showed an improvement in the detection of small fires.

articleTitle: Iris Movement Based Assistance for Catatonic Patients
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Many types of critical illnesses and injuries in human result invarious degree of immobilisation because of weakening of neuro-muscles. The patients gradually lose the potential of muscular movements of various body parts and becomes totally dependent on others for assistance. To overcome these difficulties, the attention guided technique based on eye-gaze tracking method for providing assistance to such patients is proposed The aim of this project is to develop and implement a system consisting of iris-tracking method by processing the image frames captured through real-time video feed Each obtained frame is filtered for pre-processing in order to enhance the image for eye detection. The eye detection is done using Hear cascade classifier. Eye gazing tracking algorithm is defined to track the movement of the iris. Once the eye tracking is done, the processor generates the code word corresponding to the predefined movements and transmits it to the device controller using ZigBee technology. The device controller communicates with the surrounding devices to control device status such as activating panic switch and switching ON/OFF - Electric lights, fans, etc. Once the panic switch is activated, it transmits emergency messages to the multiple registered users through GSM This interface facilitates the Catatonic patient to control various appliances without applying any physical movement.

articleTitle: An Efficient Routing Scheme for Internet Connected Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, an Energy-Efficient (EE) routing algorithm along with an energy evaluation model is proposed for cluster-based hierarchical WSNs. The proposed routing algorithm uses the randomly distributed cluster-based hierarchical architecture as the underlying platform while the energy evaluation model is designed for a centralized cluster-based hierarchical network. In this paper we proposed an Efficient Routing Algorithm Scheme for Internet Connected Devices and discussed the energy evaluation model. In WSNs, the neighboring nodes gather events which may have identical data patterns [1]. The transmission of such events to a base station may have an adverse impact on the lifetime, storage and processing capabilities of each node. In WSNs, an end user is mainly interested in the quality of transmitted data. An end user wants a brief description of events happening within a sensor field rather than huge collection of redundant data. The objective of our proposed routing algorithm is to enhance the lifetime of a WSN and improve the quality of data delivered at the base station. First, we explain the network architectural model of our proposed routing algorithm followed by its operational model.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Nanotube Junctionless Accumulation Mode MOSFETs with Ion Implanted Doping Profile
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Thispaper demonstrates the electrical characteristics such as surface potential, electric field, drain current, subthreshold swing, and thethreshold voltage of nanotube junctionless accumulation-mode MOSFETs(NJAM-M OSFETs) with ion implanted doping profile in the channel region. The ion implantation, subsequent annihilation and heat treatment of the device cause a Gaussian type doping profile. Thus, an ion implanted doping profile can be well approximated as a Gaussian doping profile. In this work, different electrical characteristics of NJAM-FETs with Gaussian type channel doping are analyzed for different straggle lengths. From the analyzed results.itcan be observed that Gaussian doping with least straggle length gives thebest performance in terms of I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</sub>/I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</sub>and short channel effects. The channel length of 40nm and inside/outside radius of 3nm/8nm has been considered for the simulated NJAM-MOSFET. All simulation results have been obtained using VisualTCAD from COGENDA.

articleTitle: Rear-View Scene Analysis Using Monocular Camera for ADAS Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Navigation and mapping along with visual scene observation in any unknown environments is a fundamental building block for increased autonomy of driving functionality or unmanned vehicles since external positioning systems can be susceptible to interference or simply being inaccessible. These advanced systems require signal processing of vehicle sensor data to estimate motion relative to the surrounding environment and to simultaneously estimate various kind of activity of the surrounding environment. Rear-view scene visualization and analysis using monocular camera is an essential task for surrounding environment modelling of any vehicle moving to forward or backward in Autonomous Driving and Driver Assistance System as well. These paper represent primarily for positional awareness, prediction of any critical situation for safety and manoeuvre in rear side environment.

articleTitle: Optimization of Circular Coil Systems for Demagnetisation of Marine Vessels
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In many fields of science and research, controllable uniform magnetic field is a key requirement. The classical way of generation of uniform magnetic field is from Helmholtz coil. Helmholtz coil produces uniform magnetic field for very small volume of occupied space. However in case of Marine applications like deperming, the volume of uniform magnetic field required is very long which cannot be acquired using Helmholtz coils due to constructional impediments. Also the degree of uniformity plays a critical role for deperming of Marine vessels. This paper proposes a mathematical optimization technique based on Mclaurian Series to design optimum geometrical placement and ampere turns requirement of each coil for the generation of higher degree homogeneous magnetic field. The positions and ampere turn ratio so obtained provide more feasibility in design of the system. The system proposed has better design parameters as compared to the conventional systems. The analytical results are compared with finite element simulation results using MATLAB and OPERA software.

articleTitle: A Spiral Design Photonic Crystal Fiber Based Surface Plasmon Resonance Biosensor with High Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper exhibits a simulation work of spiral design photonic crystal fiber (PCF) biosensor that demonstrations high sensitivity. The recommended biosensor mechanisms with surface plasmon resonance (SPR) phenomenon. The sensor performance is investigated utilizing finite element method (FEM) based software with perfectly matched layer (PML) and MATLAB software environment. In this design, gold is treated as an active plasmonic material. With a view to mitigating the fabrication challenge, gold is coated outside the fiber structure compared to inside coating on gold. The planned sensor indications the wavelength sensitivity of 2500 nm/RID (calculated by wavelength interrogation technique), the sensor resolution of \pmb4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> RIU and high linearity with the value of coefficient of determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) is equal to 0.9677. Considering its high sensing performance, this proposed sensor can be used as an excellent candidate to detect unknown analytes.

articleTitle: Motif-Based Pattern Detection Method for Smart Energy Meter Data
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Nowadays, smart energy meters are being used to record periodic electricity consumption. The real time data produced by smart meters provide the detailed information about the electricity usage of a particular consumer. In this paper, we propose the motif-based pattern detection technique to discover regular behaviors of smart meter users. The electric energy usage pattern within a specific time window characterizes behaviors of energy user. Experiments on an Irish CER dataset justify that the proposed motif-based pattern detection method discovers the useful routine behavior of smart energy meters users, which are helpful for electricity utility experts and also for users. Further, in this paper, detailed motif analysis have been presented with respect to various parameter settings such as motif size, alphabet size etc. Also, interesting motifs are extracted within the households which help distribution network operator (DNO) for LV network modeling and management.

articleTitle: Analyze Collaborative Search History for Online Query Suggestion by Applying Re-Ranking Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Web search engine pursued popularity by providing real time search results to the user while seeking of information. To investigate search result query suggestion has become the most important feature of web search engine. List of suggested queries provides the previously searched and related search results for the current search state of user. Information for any particular topic is searched by the user on the web is still in the form of queries (i.e. keywords). Keyword based query similarity faces the problem of semantic ambiguity. Graph based similarity method solves a problem of semantic ambiguity. Suggested queries are set of recommended (i.e. related) queries collected according to the similarity relevance value by analyzing search history. Dynamic clustering algorithm resolves a problem of K-Means by providing flexibility to increase the number of clusters as data object points increases. Suggested queries may vary their position in a query suggestion group, according to the relevance value calculated by relevance algorithm. Graph based similarity check method collects set of suggested queries for the currently searching query by analyzing collaborative search history. The Comparative result calculated with precision, recall and F-Measure show re-ranking algorithm gives higher accuracy than online query suggestion method.

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid Powered Automated Compressed Stabilized Earth Block (CSEB) Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The hybrid powered automated Compressed Stabilized Earth Brick (CSEB) making machine employs solar energy to hydraulically compress the soil mixture. This machine overcomes the laborious effort and low productivity of manually compressed earth bricks. This green technology mitigates the challenge of environment pollution caused by fired brick kilns. Since it is indigenous, it alleviates the necessity to import expensive automatic brick making machines. Civil construction material for rural communities in India is made affordable, and additionally it generates employment.

articleTitle: Underwater Wireless Communication and Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Underwater wireless communication has become very important parameter nowadays. our earth is almost fully equipped by water, about seventy-one percent of earth's surface is water. As the world has raised their technology level up to the top, underwater wireless communication has become fastest growing fields. our technology will grow up rapidly if we are able to give more information of underwater world to the real-time world, this is only possible by wireless communications and systems. Underwater communication is more complex and harsh wireless communication, as it is affected by many things such as marine condition, pollution, noise, limited bandwidth and many more. so, it's very important to control such parameters which would not affect again. The need for underwater wireless communications exists in various applications such as human communication underwater, disaster detections, monitoring the pollution in environmental systems, video and image transmission to the real-time world, the collection of data from water stations and many such discoveries can be obtained. and thus, underwater wireless communication has played the most important role in this competitive world.

articleTitle: Generalized Method for Stego Pixel Optimization Using Slide Value Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents a general algorithm for optimization of pixel value after data is embedded into the pixel. The simplest method is least-significant-bit substitution, embeds data in the least significant bits of the cover image. It introduces a small distortion in the cover image with the disadvantage that post processing may destroy the hidden data easily. Many data hiding techniques use higher bit position to hide data for security reasons at the cost of increased cover distortion. Distortion is increased by twice the value as hiding bit location is shifted one position towards the most significant bit. Many techniques involving bit manipulation are used to optimize the value of stego pixel byte without affecting the hidden data so that the stego byte value has minimum distortion as compared to the original value in cover image. The proposed method uses sliding value algorithm to optimize the stego pixel byte. It is divided into two parts, slide up and slide down algorithm. The best value obtained from these two sub-algorithms is taken as the final optimized value. The algorithm completely minimizes the distortion of stego byte hence increasing robustness and security. The method leaves no scope for further optimization of stego pixel value and the results show better performance.

articleTitle: An Optimal Disk Scheduling Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Secondary storage devices forms an integral part in memory management system. Disk scheduling has a direct correlation with Secondary storage management system. There are various algorithms that schedules disk in particular manner. Efficiency of any disk scheduling algorithm depends on total seek movements. Lower the seek time, better is the efficiency. This paper proposes an optimal technique which would find minimum possible seek movement for any set of incoming disk requests. This technique if applied increases throughput by reducing latency.

articleTitle: Enhancement in Security Using Extended Security Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Security has become an inseparable issue as internet is ruling the world. Every day we are doing various activities such as e-banking, e-shopping or information transfer through internet so there exists a need for safe and secure transactions. Extended visual cryptography is very advanced technique for providing security to information which will be going to transfer through network. In this paper, we exploit extended visual cryptography technique for military application security. Without sending password directly as it is from sender to receiver we are going to create shares of password and those shares will be transfer through secure server to receiver. When receiver will combine this shares then only complete password will be revealed. In this paper we provide overview of extended visual cryptography and Algorithms implementation is presented in this paper for share generation of password.

articleTitle: Simplified Design Process for Laboratory Prototype of 3-Ph 3-Level Diode Clamped Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: An orderly design method for 3-ph, 3-level diode clamped (DCMLI) voltage source inverter (VSI) is presented in this paper. This inverter produces stepped output voltage waveform from DC input source which nearly approaches to sinusoidal with reduced Harmonic Distortion in the out-put voltage wave compared to 2-level inverter. This paper presents step by step procedure for calculation of ratings of power devices and their losses, design of heat sink required based on moderate switching frequency of 2kHz. Matlab/simulink results for presented in this paper for the same switching frequency i.e. 2kHz.

articleTitle: Generating Variable Keys in Automatic Variable Key with Noise Burst Bit in Cryptography towards Data Transfer for Achieving Perfect Security
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: One technique, named as AVK, we can create keys from data to data or session to session that is known as dynamic key. Using this type of technique we can overcome the problem that arises with a static key. The same key has been used for the entire data communication in case of static key and if anyhow it has been compromised then the basic requirement of cryptography fails. In these proposed techniques, few dynamic key generation techniques have been generated and the variable keys have been generated based on some existing techniques namely, CSAVK, ASAVK, LSAVK and KVRN by incorporating noise burst bit. From the performance analysis, we have been observed that the auto generated keys are more random in the proposed techniques. The randomness of successive generated keys has been tested with the help of National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) which is a statistical tool and proved that the generated keys are truly random. Finally, we have concluded that these techniques can be used in real-time applications as they provide more security as compared to other existing schemes.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of Bi-Static Radar Cross Section of a Stealth Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: F-117 Nighthawk Stealth Fighter Jet is considered as the world's first true `Stealth' aircraft and its considerably low Radar Cross Section (RCS) has been measured in this paper. RCS is an important parameter for radar that improvises on the detectability the target accurately. Varying two of the most important parameters of RCS such as frequency of the radar transceiver and aspect angle, the best outputs are recorded as the results. Using COMSOL Multiphysics software a virtual chamber has been created and the CAD model of F-117A is applied in it. With a planar electric field as the incident radar signal, the RCS has been recorded. In this paper, the bi-static RCS calculation method is considered for simulation. The results clearly depicted that better RCS can be obtained at the upper order frequency of S band wave range (above 3.5 GHz) and at some specific aspect angles the results exhibit higher detectability.

articleTitle: A Single Phase Cascaded Asymmetric Multilevel Inverter Topology
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In multilevel inverter, asymmetric configuration uses different values of DC sources which give increased voltage levels at the output with reduction in switching devices. Topology for single phase asymmetric multilevel inverter is proposed in this paper. The simulation results of this topology shows that asymmetric configuration gives more levels at the output compared to symmetric configuration with same quantity of voltage sources and switching devices. In addition, the FFT Analysis shows that THD is reduced to a considerable amount with the asymmetric configuration.

Author Keywords: Reduced switching devices and Switching loss

articleTitle: Design and Development of Pokemon Information Center Using Restful WebServices Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In recent, gaming craze is increased by analyzing individualize games. The conclusion arises that Pokémon is a high percentage played game. POKETAB-Pokémon Information Centre is analyzing the term Pokémon and providing the information about the Pokémon, In today's environment, the Pokémon lovers have to deal with problems like they don't even know about the Pokemou's name, generation, its power. Single game players like Pokemon Go players unable to identify the pokemon places as a wide virtual space is provided in game and unfortunately loose the levels of game. In some situations players couldn't find the particular Pokémon information while playing the games. If player wants to play the game they should know the powers of Pokemon, We proposed the system which is commixing the enhancement for Pokémon information by using the restful web services in combination with JSP and creating an android mobile application so that it becomes information provider for the Pokémon game players.

articleTitle: loT Based Real-Time Harmonic Monitoring System for Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Renewable sources integration with power grid and Distributed Generation (DG) has resulted into Power Quality deterioration problems. There is a need for continuous monitoring of Harmonic injection in real-time. In this paper, we propose an end to end system based on an IIoT value chain that remotely monitors harmonic injection into grid. Entire system is built and tested on Industrial grade equipments. Monitoring is done on a remote device over MQTT via Cloud. Measurement results which are presented in real-time are compared to an EN50160complaint meter.

articleTitle: Influence of Localized Interface Charges on Drain Current of Dual-Material Double-Gate Tunnel FETs
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this work, the influence of localized interface charges on the energy band diagram, electric-field, surface potential and input-output characteristics of dual-material (DM) double-gate (DG) tunnel field-effect transistors (TFETs) have been demonstrated. These localized charges are created near the source/channel junction due to hot carrier effects (BCEs). The energy band diagram, electric field, surface potential and drain current of DM DG TFETs with and without localized interface charge density (N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>) is also stuided. A two-dimensional (2-D) numerical simulation software ATLAS™ has been used to obtain the results of DM DG TFET devices.

articleTitle: Theoretical Investigation of the Influence of Defect States on the Power Conversion Efficiency of CZTSSe Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This report presents a performance variation analysis in the presence of defect states in CZTSSe (Copper Zinc Tin Sulphur Selenide) solar cell. The presence of defect states inside the bulk of absorber layer and at interface between absorber and buffer layers were simulated and analyzed. It is observed that the extent of recombination losses gets affected by the presence of defects states in the bulk/interface and it is more prominent near the interface region than in the bulk region. The recombination losses led to the reduction in the values of open circuit voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∝</sub>), short-circuit current density (J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</sub>) and the overall power conversion efficiency (PCE) of the device in comparison to that generally achieved in CIGS and CdTe solar cells. These results highlight the need for a systematic study dedicated towards the lowering of interfacial/bulk defects to achieve the performance of CZTSSe solar cells comparable to other high performance solar cells.

articleTitle: Double Primemover, Statorless More Compact and Efficient Generators
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Electricity has become the necessity of life and humans are exploring new ways to get more output from known resources, so that the ecological balance is least impacted. We submit two concepts for Generators. In the first concept, we rotate the Stator (of conventional generator) also, with the separate prime mover/ turbine in the direction opposite to the rotor. In the second we make the rotor hollow and arrange the Stator inside using both the faces of the Electro Magnet. These concepts can be used either alone or in combination with each other, to reduce the size of the Generators and increase the efficiency. This allows for higher output to be taken from the same input, higher capacity generators to be built and the most importantly this will allow us to use the lower heads more efficiently. Both concepts, also reduces the capital cost in addition to, increase in the efficiency of the generators by reducing the mechanical, electrical and other losses. It also reduces the size of the turbines by splitting them in two (for the same rated capacity of the generator), each turbine controlling the Rotor 1 (previously the Rotor in the conventional Machine), and Rotor 2 (previously the Stator in the conventional Machine) respectively. The efficiency increase is up to approx. 7% or more, where the turbines selection changes from (Kaplan or other type for lower heads), to Francis. This change in type of turbine could not be done earlier as the type and size of the turbines and Generators are governed by the head available. Available Head governs the speed at which the efficiency of the hydro turbine is maximum. Utilization of lower heads are further governed by the limitations of the availability of materials that have the ability to take various mechanical stresses produced at runaway speeds due to bulky rotor. The selection is further limited because it should also allow the swift flow of Magnetic lines of force, without producing the eddy currents and other losses. Now by increasing the relative speed by rotating the stationary stator in opposite direction, the Generator and Turbine sizes reduce thereby reducing the mechanical stresses to be borne at runaway speed allowing us to proceed further in all directions, even with the presently known materials. The concepts can be used (either alone or in combination) for wind and thermal turbines and Generators, but the impacts and results will be different. They are also applicable to motors as well and can be used for equalizing the torque by cross compensation and further benefits are in the process to be explored. This is going to revolutionize the electrical engineering design of turbines and Generators.

articleTitle: Study and Simulation of Three Leg Impedance (Z)-Source Inverter by Simple Boost Carrier Control
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This article shows the study of low cost dc boost & three phase ac load voltage of Impedance (Z) - source inverter (ZSI). ZSI has actually very unique buck-boost capability. It allows shoot through state (short circuit) which improve the reliability of circuit. The detailed specifications of ZSI are present in this paper. The operating principle of ZSI is explained along with introduction of shoot through state by simple boost control modulation strategy. Total harmonic distortion is also obtained for ZSI using FFT analysis. The proposed ZSI can be used in grid connected PV system. Simulation results are obtained for ZSI by using simple boost control using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Performance and Correlational Analysis of Wavelet Based Compression Techniques Using Ultrasound Compound Images
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The paper presents performance analysis of wavelet techniques used for the compression of ultrasound compound images. The compression technique used includes EZW, SPIHT, STW, WDR, ASWDR, and SPIHT 3D. The quality parameters were used as an input to the correlation model for comparative performance analysis. In the study quality parameters used against each compression technique includes compression ratio (CR), bits per pixel (BPP), mean square error (MSE), peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR), normalized cross correlation(NK), average difference(AD), structural content(SC), maximum difference(MD) and normalized absolute error(NAE). The WDR compression method was observed to outperform all the other compression techniques during the analysis based on quality parameters..

articleTitle: Automatic Vegetable Leaf Cutter Based on Matlab and Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In these times of modernization, use of artificially intelligent machines becomes the need of the day. Recent developments in science and technology have brought a revolutionary change in the way the machines operate. Automated machines reduces human efforts to a large extent. Plucking of leafy vegetables is a time consuming task in our day to day lives. We know that there are many products or machinery available in market for various purposes such as cutting, chopping of leafy vegetables. The demand of the amount of leafy vegetables to be cut for dishes always remains higher than the amount of consumption. A model has been proposed in this paper using image processing and embedded systems to help find out damaged or good leafy vegetables. This method finds out the amount of chlorophyll present in leaves and hence notifies us about the amount of nourishment present in those leafy vegetables. A robotic arm has been used to pluck the leafy vegetables and hence it saves time and effort. Plus it helps in restoring essential nutrients present in the leafy vegetables which are good for our consumption.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automatic Height Adjustment Mechanism on a General Purpose Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The paper comprises of automated height adjustment mechanism analysis, conceptualization, calculation and implementation. It gives basic idea on implementation of Automated Height Adjustment mechanism on the platform (trolley) along with the help of various Mechatronics devices like Encoder, Decoder, Motor, Relays. Basically, the entire paper is divided into three stages, which are concept, review and development, design and implementations. The main function of the mechanism is to automate the vertical movement of platforms like airplane's ground support equipment, hospital trolley, weight-lifting tables for industries, factories and various applications in medical field. The purpose of the paper is to ease the work done manually and mechanically.

Author Keywords: DC Servo Motor with inbuilt gear box

articleTitle: HIV smART Monitor - A Health Care System that Monitors Pediatric Antiretroviral Therapy (ART) Drug Dosages
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The Desire Society is an NGO in Hyderabad that offers HIV infected destitute children, free medication, accommodation and food. It is imperative that the children receive proper medication and nutrition, to ensure that the disease does not progress at alarming rates and is kept under control. A key element required to ensure a success in treatment is proper adherence to the Antiretroviral Therapy(ART) drug schedule prescribed for individual patients. ART drugs should be given in specific combinations and dosages and this combination will differ from child to child. thus making it difficult for the doctors to monitor dosages for a large group of young patients. This research project is an attempt to create a Health Care System called HIV smART Monitor for the Desire society that can be used to monitor correct adherence to the ART drug schedule, drug combination and drug dosage for the infected HIV children. The project has currently been implemented in the Hyderabad office and orphanage of the Desire Society, where it is being successfully used by doctors and the healthcare workers.

articleTitle: A Load Balancing Framework in Cloud to Support Task Processing Using Smartphone with CWC
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The main objective of this paper was to propose cloud supporter framework to support cloud for processing multiple tasks. Because of multiple tasks on cloud server, it works slower and sometimes gets failed. In this situation distributing or scheduling of tasks on the distributed computing system is the only solution to reduce workload on server. Computing capability of smart phones CPU can compete with the CPU of the computers. Smart phones are energy-efficient and cost-effective alternative to running certain tasks of traditional servers. Distributing tasks for computations must utilize all the resources equally, no resource should be under or over utilize this problem leads to focus on the load balancing technique to support the cloud for processing tasks. Our approach is to form a load balancing frame work as cloud supporter for processing tasks on smart phones when they are plugged into the power sources.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Hand-Coded and Automated Feature Based Algorithms for Human Detection in Embedded Application
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Human detection in the video frame is a difficult task and time consuming process. Inherent characteristics like posture, mien, physique and alien features like radiance, blockage, cluster, litter are prominent factors effecting the task. The main aim of this paper is to implement, compute and compare different algorithms in unfavorable conditions and conclude the output parameters of the algorithm on real time videos. In this paper, three feature based algorithms Single Shot Multibox Detector (SSD), Haar Cascade and Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) are computed. The comparison of this algorithms in real life scenarios and on different platforms are being computed to find out which algorithm is suitable for an embedded application.

articleTitle: Self-Adaptive Woman Health Monitoring System Using MAPE Components
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In the model-driven software development, various models are generated during development process. In traditional software engineering, due to stable requirements development models were fixed during complete development. But some of these models are changed at runtime if requirements specifications are changed for modern software systems. To manage the changes at runtime, runtime models are developed and used. The developed software will be self-adaptive with self-optimizing and self-healing capabilities.
