abstract: In this paper, we investigate the outage performance of a cooperative and cognitive radio system where two secondary users (SUs) communicate through a relay via the two-way relaying. The coexistence of SUs with the primary users (PUs) in the same spectrum is possible by using underlay protocol, where the interference at the PU receiver is under a predefined threshold. Focusing on the cooperation process among the SU nodes and making use of the underlay cognitive approach, we derive the exact user outage probability(OP) in closed-form. Furthermore, the tight closed-form expression for the end to end OP is also derived, which is declared when any of a SU is in the outage. Our analysis employs transmit/receive beamforming at the SU nodes and analog network coding at relay node where opportunistic selection algorithm is deployed for selecting best relay in underlay scenario. Furthermore, we have derived the asymptotic performance and thus focus on the performance gain achieved by multi-relay and multiantenna diversity under Nakagami-m fading. Besides, we also evaluate the optimized locations for the relay under practical scenarios to minimize the OP. Monte Carlo simulation results are presented to corroborate the proposed analysis.

articleTitle: Proposed 4SM Model for Indian Education System Implementing Big Data Analytics and Blended Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the technology at the center of much uproar and improvising these days, the application of big data and blended learning in the current Indian education system is the need of the hour. It has been observed that the data is growing at a fast pace, therefore there must be certain techniques which will help to improve the conventional teaching methods in order to tackle with the young minds curiosities. To address the issue, a new educational model called 4-Step-Model is proposed. It can be used in parallel that support both the online and traditional face-to-face learning. Model includes- Planning, Modeling, Implementation and Testing phase. It implements big data analytics and blended learning methods to access the technology usage. Utilizes advanced analytics method combining learning analytics and blended learning techniques aiming to enhance the quality of education. The potential outcome of this model will be improved results in the learning behavior of a student such as better performance, enhanced learning effect, and advanced growth rates. This underlines the need and significance of 4SM as an educational model with the talent already in the hands of an educator and learner that can be used to incorporate technology in the educational bodies.

articleTitle: Convergence of Multi-Agent Systems to Unknown Source of an Odor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This study is aimed at investigating a solution to the problem of odor source localization by multi-agent systems. It has been assumed that the agents are homogeneous having uncertain dynamics. A hierarchical cooperative control has been proposed as a solution to the problem. In the first layer, information about wind and concentration has been utilized using a measurement model and swarm intelligence to predict the probable location of source. Trajectory mapping has been done in the second layer, followed by distributed cooperative control in the third layer. The control layer attempts to drive the agents into consensus to locate the odor source, wherein a sliding mode controller has been designed owing to its inherent robustness and powerful disturbance rejection capabilities. Numerical simulations have been presented to illustrate the efficacy of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Task Migration Algorithm to Reduce Temperature Imbalance Amongst Cores in Linux Based Multi-Core Processor Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Multi-core architectures have recently emerged as the main design paradigm for current and future processors, however, the addition of multiple cores on the same chip and simultaneous execution of processes on these cores increases the temperature imbalance amongst cores and result in an increase in chip temperature, which in turn reduces the reliability of the processor. In this research project, the problem of temperature imbalance amongst cores in multi-core processor systems is addressed at the operating system level via task migration. The proposed task migration algorithm finds out the thermal contribution of individual task and performs the task migration based on this thermal contribution, in order to maintain temperature balance amongst cores. The proposed task migration algorithm is implemented in Linux operating system by modifying the source code written in C language. Different categories of processes (e.g. CPU bound, IO bound etc.) are executed from Phoronix Test Suite and Sysbench Benchmarks to test the performance of the proposed algorithm. Experimental results for the existing task migration algorithm of Linux and the proposed task migration algorithm show that the proposed algorithm reduces the temperature imbalance amongst cores as compared to existing algorithm, without degrading the performance.

articleTitle: Network Jitter Analysis with varying TCP for Internet Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Conventionally, IP network planning, design and optimization is mostly based on the throughput and average delay which can often be easily calculated. Network Jitter, on the other hand, is much more difficult to evaluate, but it is particularly important to manage the QoS of real-time and interactive services such as VoIP and streaming video. Queuing delay and congestion control are closely related to jitter and happen at the network layer, therefore jitter is analyzed at the network layer in this paper. Initially arrival and service processes for multiplexed TCP and UDP traffic at the output queue, of the router are modeled. The model accounts for the fraction of TCP and UDP datagrams, the arrival and service distributions of TCP and UDP with their respective datagram sizes. Network Jitter is then derived using the arrival and service process model for tagged traffic flow of either TCP or UDP with background traffic. The derivation is extended to calculate end-to-end network jitter of a tagged stream. The findings of the analysis is then compared with NS2 simulations. The interesting finding is that network jitter increases for the tagged traffic as the fraction of TCP increases in the background traffic. Higher the quantum of TCP is the background traffic worst is the network jitter for tagged traffic. This is particularly important because TCP dominates the overall traffic. The simulation results fairly agree with the analytical values. The conclusion is true for Cubic, Reno and compound TCP flavors.

articleTitle: Morphology-Based Extraction of River Network from Multidimensional Topographic LiDAR Returns
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Data acquired from sensors such as those from LiDAR devices contain a large set of data points per unit area. These data sets are multidimensional in nature and correspond to features on the topographic region often obtained from laser sensors as point cloud returns. These data returns can help to identify spatial features on the earth surface. Segmenting and extracting regions into land, vegetation and water bodies such as rivers, lakes, and ponds from these multidimensional topographic point clouds is a challenging problem. It is found that LiDAR returns vary according to the surface composition and gives high returns for hard solid and opaque features to low or minimal returns for soft water bodies. This paper explores the relevance and applicability of using spatial morphology-based approach to extract regions of water bodies in the study area. The results suggest that spatial morphological model helps us to identify and extract progressively regions of water bodies or its immediate influence regions. The results are encouraging with high accuracy up to 98.96% in detecting and extracting water bodies within their spatial setups.

articleTitle: House-Viz: A Methodology to Visualize Search Results for Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In an era of Information Overload, wherein we get millions of results for a simple search query executed on the web, it is quite challenging to go through each one of the search results and remember the features of each, to later compare it with other results. This paper focuses on a tool, called House-Viz, which simplifies our process of decision making, by creating interactive visualizations for our search results. This makes it feasible to look at the bigger picture for effective comparison of these results at a single glance, hence summarize the content. This tool addresses such a problem in the domain of Real Estate, wherein people are now-a-days trying to find their dream homes, best suited for their needs, online. The characteristics of this tool, is exemplified by taking into consideration various houses and their different features, and searching the right set of houses according to your search preferences. Its potential is then shown by visualizing these search results of various houses and their features, using two novel visualization techniques, one in 2-D and the other in 3-D, which help us in effectively analyzing and comparing the various houses, and thus, simplifying our decision to find the right home.

articleTitle: Towards Trusted Computing-A Novel Holistic Policy Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Trust means first party is entrusting the second party with their assets in good will; that, it will be kept safe. In computing paradigm, the users entrust their data including personally identifiable information with service provider such as social networking sites. Service providers have the responsibility of keeping the user's data safe from misuse and exploitation. Trust is gained when the service provider can prove that they are keeping the data safe. For this, it needs to be auditable and complaint to data privacy laws. Web services hosted on the cloud are vulnerable to data security threats. Also, privacy and data policy of service providers indicate that they share user data including personally identifiable information with third parties like advertisers. Data sharing policies of service providers need to be revisited and trustable solutions need to be proposed. Holistic data privacy policies need to designed by law enforcement agencies which hold the service providers accountable. There is a pleading need for policy based trustable framework for handling of data in cloud based services, especially in social networking. In current work, we discuss these concerns and propose a holistic policy based approach to solve the research problem and move towards trusted computing.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient and Low Complexity Signal Detection with Generalized Spatial Modulation for Massive MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Large scale Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) has been widely used in the communication field for enabling high speed data transmission. Since it uses large number of transmitting antenna, the signal detection is complicated. When noticing, the performance of the system is affected by the system configurations and mechanism. In this work, generalized spatial modulation (GSM) based transmission is used in Rayleigh fading channel with known channel correlations and fading loss. The transmission mode selection based on energy efficiency is proposed based on BER requirement which reduces the complexity. The signal detection approach, Maximum likelihood QR decomposition algorithm (MLQR) is proposed with low computational complexity. The proposed approach decomposes the channel coefficients into two matrices and the likelihood detection is used for simplifying the process. The performance of the proposed approach is evaluated with the Bit error rate (BER), and Energy efficiency. The performance measure of the proposed approach is compared with the conventional approaches for showing the efficiency.

articleTitle: Biometric Traits in Enhancing Security of Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Imperative importance of utilization of the biometrics technologies in every industry is enhancing security and privacy of the system while handling proper identification and verification process. The healthcare industry is also addressed by biometric systems carrying body sensor details with linking each other including key factors of authentication and authorization processes. This paper reveals approaches of security utilization of biometrics technologies and their optimal points, biometric dealings with encryption and the importance of the process of healthcare services enroll with biometric specifications, issues and drawbacks of systems.

articleTitle: Improving the Performance of Biological Data Analysis in Cloud Computing Platforms
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the development of biological analysis techniques there is a massive generation of biological data and advanced sequencing strategies are implemented. The prevailing computing infrastructure is not sufficient enough to accumulate the data storage and data sequencing strategies. Hence for the improvement of the performance on biological data analysis, cloud computing platform can be used. The various methodologies of data manipulation and sequencing are used on the cloud platform. They can be addressed as cloud virtualization, cloud BioLinux and Hadoop with MapReduce. The purpose of this review paper is to critically analyze usage of cloud computing platforms to improve the performance biological data analysis and find the most appropriate cloud techniques for various analyzing phenomena.

articleTitle: SHUSHRUTA - Health and Disease Information System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Medical diagnosis is a complicated task and it should be performed precisely and efficiently and its automation will be extremely helpful. All medical practitioners are unfortunately not similarly skilled in every subspecialty and they are a rare asset in many places. With the accessible past records, it is conceivable to develop a framework that can analyze, examine(geographically & statistically) and evaluate the epidemiological data, disease burdens and clinical trials being generated throughout the nation. However, there is still no known general framework that intends to analyze as well visualize the health records. We exhibit SHUSHRUTA(Health & Disease Information System) an extensible wise online framework for disease prediction and epidemiological examination and visualization of Clinical Laboratory Test(CLT) reports. We depict in more detail about the decision making process using data visualization and additionally a forecast system that provides future trends of diseases.

articleTitle: Handwritten Computer Program Recognition, Compilation & Execution Application
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Make a computer program that does automatically recognize a handwritten computer program, compile and execution is extremely difficult. The reasons are the various types, shapes of handwritten characters of different peoples. Among other issues in optical character recognition, accurate handwritten identification is the main research issue. This paper provides an accurate handwritten computer program recognition method, which blend with the image processing and the language training for handwritten characters. Further, automatic error correction of handwritten program, compilation and execution of the program, will be discussed in detail throughout the paper. The final evaluation results show that the newly developed system can identify the handwritten computer program syntaxes with a higher level of accuracy.

articleTitle: Dynamic Clustering and GPU Based Parallel Processing Approach to Accelerate Circuit Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this digital era, electronic circuit is the key component and its design is tested and validated through simulator. Simulator uses mathematical model to replicate circuit behavior. All electronic designs rely truly on simulation software. But even though simulation is cost-effective; large circuit simulation is relatively time consuming. Also various iterations in transient analysis may make simulation slower. Fast simulator is the basic requirement for large circuit simulation. In this paper, we have addressed parallel computing approach using Graphics Processing Unit(GPU) to accelerate simulation. As GPU is many core processor, compute intensive functions are redesigned to execute on GPU. Matrix operations, linear-nonlinear equations, integration, differential equations, numerical methods are some of the very basic operations required in circuit analysis. Mathematical operations are redesigned to get clusters of sufficient size. Forming clusters of circuit components and mathematical procedures proves to be crucial, for reliable mapping to graphics processor. Loop replacement, data-code partitioning, parallel data mapping, reductions, fast memory access are the strategies adopted for parallel processing on GPU. More than 40% speed gain is achieved on circuit having at least four components and transient analysis for more than thousand iterations.

articleTitle: Enterprise Search: A New Dimension in Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Prior to the 1980's, the primary focus in the field of Information Retrieval was document retrieval and finding the exact documents matching the user's needs, from his desktop. However, since 1980 with the invention of the Internet, there has been a paradigm shift with much of this data being transferred online. The amounts of data available on the Internet has been growing exponentially with more than two billion unique, publicly accessible web pages on the Internet. With this ever growing data, the need for finding important data also increased and this lead to inception of search engines such as Google, Yahoo! to fetch this data online. Consequently, with new and improved search algorithms for these search engines, the web search today has improved tremendously, with millions of results being generated within seconds. However, these search engines that crawl the web do not access the internal data of a company, that is confidential and being circulated in its ecosystem. This data includes its databases, intranet websites, portals etc. The process of accurately retrieving data from the internal ecosystem of an organization is called as Enterprise Search. Over the last few years, research in the field of Enterprise Search has often been overlooked. This has led to quite a few problems with organizations failing to manage all its data spread across various platforms. In this paper, we try to bring Enterprise Search back into limelight, by stressing its importance as a full-proof solution for managing an organization's data. This is done by shedding light on the recent research in Enterprise Search, the challenges it faces, its advantages over conventional search solutions. Finally, we provide a comprehensive survey of the various Enterprise Search systems available in the market, and their features. The motive behind this paper is to encourage the employment of Enterprise Search systems in every organization, owing to the potential benefits it provides to its employees as well as the productivity of the company as a whole.

articleTitle: An Optimized Transform Domain Watermarking Technique for Grayscale Images of Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Watermarking is a useful technique for copyright management. It is widely used in various types of digital content management application of grayscale and colour images. But as of now, there has been no method to watermark for a grayscale image using a colour image. In this paper, a unique watermarking for the grayscale image scheme in the transform domain has been proposed. The presented technique is suitable for the digital rights and security management of the diagnostic medical images in the online database. The proposed watermarking method is composed of Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Additionally, we have used the Firefly Algorithm (FA) to compute appropriate scaling factor to achieve higher perceptibility and robustness. Performance metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, and NCC are used to evaluate the technique. Experimental analysis shows that the proposed technique is 40-45% improved over the existing methods and almost 50% watermark is recoverable under different image processing attacks proving robustness of the technique.

articleTitle: Framework for Integrating SPE with Web Services Development Model
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The web is an evolving system that incorporates new components and services at a very rapid pace. Web applications and Web services increase the traffic in the communication channels at an even higher rate. Millions of requests are received by well-known websites. The high response times that are exhibited by these websites can create frustration for their users. The website's administrators face the problem of adequate sizing of their infrastructure in order to provide quality service for their users. This challenge forces them to keep track of the performance of their websites, as well as the web services offered by them. Hence, it is required to estimate the intensity of the workload, to identify bottlenecks and determine capacity shortcomings. This helps in determining the most effective way to improve the performance by providing solutions for increasing workload demands. In this paper, we describe a process model to integrate SPE with web services development model. A framework is proposed to support the process model, and the elements of the framework are presented. The framework provides flexibility to apply SPE methodologies on web services development model for predicting the performance in various aspects of web services. The Travel care web application is considered to demonstrate the elements of the framework. The performance metrics is obtained and analysed. Sensitivity analysis is carried out to study the behavior of the hardware resources so that the capacity of the deployment environment can be determined.

articleTitle: Thought Process Based Team Member Selection Using Contextual Sentiment Closeness
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: It is the teamwork that makes projects, companies and teams successful. Person alone is constrained by limitations. Even people with no shared thought processes and conflicting opinions cannot work together. Project undertaken by such teams lead to disastrous outcomes. Can two persons work together effectively? Can we determine and associate thought process to form effective groups? This paper focuses on determining thought process association of two persons to find out whether they can work together. This paper finds out closeness between responses by two individuals with reference to given context to determine whether they can work together in given scenario. The paper proposes contextual sentiment closeness (CSC) algorithm for the same. The algorithm further uses scenario pointer based reinforcement learning where team members collect thought process based rewards and penalties. Temporal Difference learning based approach calculates the maximum possible rewards and even suggest certain modifications required if any. This approach can help in selection of members for mission, projects and any critical activity. The selection based on responses compared with human selection on 200 samples and it gave over 81% accuracy.

articleTitle: Two level CFAR Algorithm for Multiple Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Cell Averaging constant False Alarm (CA-CFAR)achieves optimum probability of detection in homogeneous environment but its performance degrades in presence of multiple targets in the reference window. During operational scenarios, the aircrafts fly close by in formation with almost same speed. This results in mutual target masking in range CFAR resulting in detection loss. In this paper, we are proposing Two level CFAR algorithm. In first level, input data is modified only for very high strength targets. The modified input from first level is used to perform CA-CFAR in second level. This algorithm is evaluated with simulated as well as real data for performance metrics such as detection performance with varying SINR, CFAR loss and computational load in comparison with CA-CFAR.

articleTitle: Solar Powered BLDC Drive with Hybrid Energy Storage System Using Zeta Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The increasing importance of renewable sources in the field of automotive sector encourages the use of solar photovoltaic (PV) system powered brushless DC motor (BLDC) drives. To overcome the limitations associated with conventional DC-DC converters, zeta converter is used as power processing stage in this paper to optimize power processing. The extraction of maximum power from solar PV system is done by providing switching pulses to zeta converter through incremental conductance (INC) maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm. Integration of hybrid energy storage system (HESS) is employed to maintain constant voltage across the BLDC motor drive despite of variation in power output of solar PV system. A dual loop control strategy is employed for power management between solar PV system and HESS. The performance of the proposed system for variation in irradiation levels and load torque is demonstrated using MATLAB/Simulink. The real-time validation of the proposed controller is done through the Xilinx system generator platform interfaced with Zynq ZC-702 FPGA kit.

articleTitle: Implementation of 8 Bit Microprocessor Using Current Mode Logic (CML) Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Many circuits and Micro-Architectural innovations have been proposed to reduce voltage swing, delay and area in many individual processor units. For this purpose, in this work, a case study is presented with a possible new design methodology of microprocessor based on CML approach. It focuses on the applicability of Current mode logic for building digital circuits, which run at very low voltages and provide desirable performance with excellent energy savings compared to conventional CMOS. The 8-Bit Microprocessor was designed in 45nm technology using CML Approach at a power supply of 1V using cadence virtuoso tools. The design of 8 Bit microprocessor consists of two functional blocks i.e. data path unit and control unit. The internal blocks of Data path unit are 8 BIT ALU, 4*8 Register file, 8 Bit Tristate buffer and 8 Bit shifter. The control unit is designed using Finite State Machines.

articleTitle: Printed Crescent-Shaped Monopole Antenna with Defected Ground Structure for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents, the design of a crescent-shaped monopole patch antenna with Defected Ground Structure (DGS), which is optimized and simulated for mobile/wireless applications. The bandwidth of a proposed antenna is enhanced by the addition of parasitic patch and creation of a T-shaped notch in the partial ground plane. The antenna is studied in terms of gain, return loss, radiation pattern and current distribution. This proposed design augments the bandwidth (defined by 10 dB return loss) upto 2.8 GHz in the frequency range of 1.56-4.36 GHz, which is two times greater than the standard antenna. It also shows good radiation pattern at various frequencies such as 2.1, 2.4, 2.8, 3.3, 3.5 and, 3.7 GHz within the operating range and performs the broadband operation. Further, the gain of this antenna has been studied which is achieved up to 4.11 dB, which could be applicable in several wireless frequency bands such as UMTS (1.9-2.1 GHz), DCS (1.7-1.8 GHz), ISM band (2.4-2.485 GHz), WLAN bands (2.4/3.6 GHz).

articleTitle: Harmonic Impact of Grid Connected Photovoltaic System on Low Voltage Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Harmonics is a common problem which persists in all types of system; however there is certain limit of harmonic as defined by IEEE standard. If the harmonic is below that limit then the system operation will be satisfactory. Now a day the demand of Grid connected Photovoltaic system (PV) is increasing continuously because cost of installation is reducing. The acceptable value of PV connection depends on various parameters. Unregulated utilization of Photovoltaic system can have a large impact on load characteristics and system power quality. This paper discusses the harmonic impact on power system due to large integration of PV system. The novelty of the paper is that the harmonic capability of power distribution system is analyzed for different PV system loading. For Simulation study PV Connected distribution system of Dr. C. V. Raman University, Kota is considered. ETAP Software is used to perform the simulation study. The system parameter is taken from actual site condition.

articleTitle: Hardware Resource Optimization for Embedded System Design: A Brief Review
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Optimization has a significant role in designing a system. An embedded system is expected to meet user specifications and optimize the hardware and software requirements to reduce design cost and complexity. The key parameters used for hardware optimization includes the number of components utilized, execution time, memory requirements, power consumption and resource allocation. Several optimization techniques have been proposed in the literature to address the same. Evolutionary algorithm is considered as one of the most commonly used optimization technique for various engineering and non-engineering applications. A review of various hardware optimization approaches using different variants of evolutionary algorithms and their performance evaluation over traditional methods are reported in this paper.

articleTitle: Automatic Video Processing Based on IoT Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this era of modernization, use of Internet has increased to a huge extent. Automation brought about by technology has saved human efforts to a large extent. The Internet of Things has revolutionized the way of communication. Communication is a powerful tool to exchange information and ideas. The evolution in science and technology which has taken place in the last decade is commendable. Video communication has quickly become a business standard in many industries. Video communication aids in Telecommuting, humanizing the conversation, bridging the communication gap and much more. Video processing is an important process of video communication. Many parameters like video quality, data losses, cost effectivity of model, relative humidity, fog play an important role. Video communication allows businesses to commute more effectively. Hence, a digital system for automatic video processing based on the concept of Internet of Things using Raspberry Pi's has been proposed.

articleTitle: A Dual Band on Body Monopole Antenna for WiMAX and X-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A compact dual-band on body unique monopole antenna having the slotted ground structure with a desired dual band is offered. It is operating on a dual-band range from 3GHz to 4.5GHz under the coverage of WiMAX range(3.3-3.6GHz) with a Bandwidth efficiency of 42% and from 8GHz-12GHz with a Bandwidth efficiency of 40 %. The prototype of proposed antenna which has used FR-4 dielectric material as the substrate which has a very small and compact configuration as 0.22AxO.26AxO.016A (where λ is the wavelength of the lowest operating frequency of the antenna.) The antenna proposed has successfully implemented on the body which has given a very fine impedance matching with dual passbands. The SAR, specific absorption rate is also under desired range in both the pass bands. The proposed design can be availed for broadband communicational services plus for satellite communication purposes and military applications.

articleTitle: Methods for Calculating the Transformer Hot-Spot Temperature and Lifetime Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper the methods for calculating the transformer hot-spot temperature are presented. One of these methods is based on the consideration of the harmonic load current and another one is based on the changes in the viscosity of oil under varying temperature conditions. The results obtained with and without considering the harmonics are compared. In addition, the results obtained with and without considering the viscosity changes are also compared. The setup is simulated in MATLAB simulink to obtain hot-spot temperature for the transformer of rating 25 MVA, 66/11 kV with ONAF cooling.

articleTitle: SISC: Sensor-Based Intelligent Shopping Cart
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The most inconvenient part in the shopping mall is waiting in the queues and lack of product information or sales, which consumes more time at billing counters. The proposed system SISC will give the customer a quick shopping experience by providing product sales promotion on the customer's smartphone using machine learning algorithms, and update total bill amount on a display screen attached to cart using RFID technology. This will make sure to the customer, shopping is under budget or over budget and also direct promotions on a smartphone will arouse his/her purchasing desire. Also, this system will reduce the supermarket budget invested in the manpower.

articleTitle: An Approach Towards Brain Controlled System Using EEG Headband and Eye Blink Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a technique to capture the brainwaves, which are generated due to the activities of the human brain on the scale of micro-electrical voltage. In recent times there is growing demand for wearable EEG technology, which helps people to suppress anxiety and increase concentration. Traditional research-grade EEG recording techniques are bulky and require skillful assistance during experimentation. Such experimental kits are typically big, costly, and handled by people who are trained on how to use them. Since the introduction of wearable EEG technology, one can record the similar activity by means of easy-to-use, inexpensive and much smaller wearable devices. Although, benefits and research opportunities in wearable EEG technology are yet to be fully discovered. It's helping society to monitor health and fitness with ease, where one can see and interact with the body in innovative and exciting ways. Still, a lot of people are unaware of wearable EEG technology benefits and usage. Here, we discuss an approach to a brain-controlled system using wearable EEG technology devices available in the market. This approach can be implemented to control various systems such as wheelchair, robots, home appliances, etc. with the help of brainwaves which are generated on eye blink.

articleTitle: Optimization of Area of CMOS Differential Amplifier Using Modified PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: As the complexity of the modern era electronic circuits increased; there arose a need for more accurate devices. The use of high-end modern equipment has penetrated into different levels of society that the need for more compact and less costly devices became the key objective of circuit designing. Keeping these two points in mind, the designing., as well as optimization., is carried out to find the best possible design parameter values. This work presents the optimized values of various parameters of a CMOS differential amplifier for better performance. The modified particle swarm optimization (MPSO) technique is chosen for optimizing the circuit area. The obtained results from MPSO is also verified in the Cadence.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Capacity Value Estimation Using Peak Period Method in Rajasthan
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper deals with calculation of capacity value of renewable energy (solar and wind energy) in Rajasthan. Capacity value refers to the contribution of a power plant to reliably meet peak power demand. This implies that if a 150 MW solar plant has a capacity value of 50%, it can contribute 75 MW of power to reliably meet demand, and thus reduce the strain on conventional power generation plants. The capacity value calculations involve the comparison of hourly capacity factor of the grid connected renewable energy plants in the state, with the state's hourly demand met, and hence provide an understanding of the contribution of renewable energy towards meeting system reliability. In this paper, the capacity value has been calculated for different districts in Rajasthan with respect to the state's hourly demand data. Four districts are considered for wind energy estimation and five districts are considered for solar energy estimation. The results of all districts considered in this analysis have been combined and showcased at the state level. Capacity value calculations have been done for solar system, wind system, as well as a combined solar and wind system at the state level.

articleTitle: Integration of Distributed Generator for Frequency Regulation and Loss Compensation Ancillary Services
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Imperatives related to regular power generation and new progressions in Distributed Generator(DG) advancements is the motivation behind why a considerable measure of consideration has been picked up by distributed power generation lately. The power system economical operation and that too with optimum levels of reliability have been the causes of increased interest in distributed generator. Achieving the goals-minimized loss and regulated frequency, necessitate that DG has been placed at optimal location. The focal reason for this paper is to gives some broad discourses how to utilize distributed generator(DG) to give ancillary services. Apart from power generation, DG can also be used to provide ancillary services. In controlling local variables like power loss reduction and frequency regulation, compelling contributions can be taken out by DG in the local connection and near consumers. Finding optimal distributed generator allocation for loss reduction and minimum Frequency regulation are going to be the primary essences of this paper. We will address the related results by performing comparative studies. A diagnostic system is utilized as a part of request to locate the ideal area of Distributed Generator. MATLAB software is used to program the proposed technique. It's been perceptibly recommended by the outcomes that Electrical line losses can be decreased by DG. In addition to that, the reliability of the system can be improved as well.

articleTitle: IoT Based Home Automation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Internet-of-Things (IoT) being the forked process of internet services and an emerging trend in technology has attracted a rapid attention in the scope of home automation. IoT forms an integral part for smart operation of home, its security and integrity controlled by human/autonomous interfaces. Each sub domain of IoT based home automation itself reflects a potentially vulnerable research area. It is in this interest that this present communication divides the entire zone of IoT based home automation research into specific interconnected research zones based on certain attributes. Each zone forms a node in the Taxonomy Tree which has been generated using Cosine Similarity Function. The prime objective of this study is to provide prospective researchers with node wise first hand collection of published research and relevant statistics, thereby minimizing effective literature survey duration.

articleTitle: Novel Approach to Find the Various Stages of Chronic Myeloid Leukemia Using Dynamic Short Distance Pattern Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Leukemia is a commonly occurring disease which is mainly seen in Kerala. There are four types of Leukemia, they are, Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML), Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL), Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML), Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia (ALL). In this work, we are finding the various stages of Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML) using DSDPM algorithm. Chronic Myeloid Leukemia is a cancer of blood or bone-marrowit is the uncontrolled production of blood cells-leukocytes/white blood cells in due to high GAMA radiation. In existing system, when there is huge data, it is inefficient and consumes more time, and multiple comparisons of persons at a time are not possible and finding the stages is difficult. So here we are going to develop an innovative approach for finding the optimal sequence alignment to reduce the time, space complexity and increase the efficiency of sequence alignment in the large data set and find the stages of CML. Here we are using innovative DSDPM algorithm, it is dynamic and recursive optimal distance calculation method to reduce the execution of time and making it cost effective for finding the mutation and optimal sequence alignment. The DSDPM uses the split distance method. When a match occurs, the sequence split based on distance result and then result will be utilized for next transition. After aligning the sequence, we will find the various stages of CML based on a number of matches, mismatches, and gaps occurred. Through this work, we are comparing the normal sequence and affected sequence of CML for predicting the different stages of CML and find the suitable drug dosage for CML.

articleTitle: Implementation of Polarization-Conversion in Ring-Resonator and its Application to Design All-Optical NOT Logic Gate
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: All-optical NOT logic gate is theoretically described using the concept of polarization-conversion in ring resonator. Conversion of polarization states occurs at very high speed of 0.2 ps and high Q-factor of about 1500 is obtained. The design may used in intensity based all-optical switching as well as in designing of all-optical logic gates. Low pump power of about 40 nW/ m is required for such conversion based all-optical gates. Suitability in pumping, refractive index contrast, height-to-width ratio of waveguide and phase-matching condition is necessary to obtain such results.

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Validation of Voice Coil Motor for High Precision Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Flexural structures are extensively beneficial when differentiated with conventional inflexible body structures where point accuracy positioning is strongly required extending in the range of microns. To fulfill clear and accurate positioning requirements, we come up with the solution of voice coil motors (VCM) with position estimator algorithm. Appropriate magnet and coil assembly is designed by considering the ultimate force for the application. Voice coil motor components are fabricated on milling machine and then assembled. This VCM is incorporated with dSPACE DS1104 R&D controller with the help of linear current amplifier (LCAM) which controls VCM with respect to desired amplitude and frequency. Displacement of coil of VCM is detected with respect to fixed magnet by using linear variable differential transformer (LVDT) which generates analog voltage signal in relation with motion of coil. Static characteristic such as stiffness is determined using force-deflection plot and dynamic characteristic like damping factor and frequency response are estimated with the help of transient response obtained by providing step input to the motor. Further, PID controller is implemented on this VCM and it is error observed is less than ±0.S microns.

articleTitle: A Post-Disaster Humanitarian Relief Logistic Model: Evacuation and Transportation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In the unpredictable event such as natural or human caused disaster, humanitarian relief logistic is one of the most important part of the response phase of the Disaster Management Operation. Relief logistics basically aims to save lives, restricts the amount of damage to the minimum and provide humanitarian goods to the anguished people. In this paper, we classify the disaster prone area into two categories according to the devastation: one is worst affected and another is less affected zone. In such an anarchic situation, the victims of the worst affected areas are to be shifted to less affected for accommodation. Regarding the distressing condition of the victims, humanitarian items are to be provided to all the victims in order to relief them. In this prospects we develop a relief logistic model, minimizing the total cost, including procurement cost, operating cost, storage cost of humanitarian items, transportation cost and penalty cost for unsatisfied demand in a disaster management operation. Furthermore, the model has been solved by LINGO 13.0 optimization solver. Finally, a real life example has been considered to show the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Vehicle Breaking Support System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Smart Automatic Braking System controls the speed of a vehicle depending on the distance to an obstacle and also can initiate emergency braking automatically if needed. In this project report, the implementation of a Smart Automatic Braking System is introduced. A prototype vehicle is designed and implemented. The System will detect obstacles using Sonar Sensor and Arduino will execute emergency braking according to a pre-burnt code in the Arduino. The system has also speed control features. It will reduce or increase the speed of the vehicle depending on the obstacle distance from the moving vehicle to minimize the damage or collision of an accident. Hence, an automated collision avoidance system is proposed that can be affordable to everyone. So, an automated Smart Speed control and Braking system is developed which can be developed in every car. This project used the software Proteus to establish simulation model.

articleTitle: Driving-Point Impedance and Particle Swarm Optimization Based Circuit Synthesis of Power Transformer Winding
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Power transformer constitutes an integral part of the power system. To assure its continuous operation, various condition monitoring techniques are being used. Frequency Response Analysis (FRA) is used to detect mechanical deformations in power transformer. Detailed modelling of transformer winding is done in order to obtain internal physical structure (equivalent ladder circuit model). In this paper, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) method is used to synthesize equivalent circuit model of power transformer winding. Initially, driving-point impedance is obtained by performing FRA and then, circuit synthesis is performed using PSO. This paper also describes approximation of various parameters of lumped circuit and leads the solution towards best optimum solution with the help of appropriate constraints. The accuracy and reliability of proposed method is found satisfactory.

articleTitle: Fault Current & Fault Voltage Analysis of Power Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Power distribution networks such as distribution substations plays very important role while distributing power to the consumers. Analysis of fault for distribution network of power is very necessary. Fault analysis can be done by various methods such as symmetrical components, MVA method, percentage impedance, percentage admittance method, per unit method. From all these fault analysis method, symmetrical component method is accurate. This method requires less time for calculations. This method is fast as compare to other methods. Here values of fault current and fault voltages at 33 kV bus is calculated with the help of Matlab.

articleTitle: Concentrated Solar Power Tracker Using Arduino UNO and Stepper Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Solar Energy is turning into an upcoming essential method for sustainable power source asset. By concentrating sunlight along with solar power tracking, it will be conceivable to generate greater power as a sunlight based board can keep up with the opposite profile to the concentrated beams of the sun. This prototype talks about the plan and development of a model for concentrated sunlight based power following framework that utilizes single hub flexibility. Here, two Light Dependent Resistors (LDRs) are utilized for daylight discovery, each on the diametrically opposite sides of the dish. The control circuit depends on Arduino UNO i.e. an ATMega328P microcontroller. It is customized to recognize daylight by means of two LDRs before setting or pivoting the stepper engine to position the inward mirror (dish in this prototype) towards the greatest force of sunrays. Driving a stepper engine to an exact position is much basic and a solitary drive heartbeat that will move the engine shaft on stage, starting with one post then onto the next. A dish secured with a reflecting sheet is utilized for the curved mirror, in order to focus the daylight on the sun powered board. This will help us to give more productive vitality even when the daylight is less. One of the approaches to expand the effectiveness of sun oriented board while diminishing expense is to utilize concentrated sunlight based power tracker. Through fixation and following, there will be expanded presentation of the board to the sun giving an expanded power yield.

articleTitle: Compact Dual Band Patch Antenna Using Meandered Complementary Split Ring Resonators
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a metamaterial inspired resonator is employed to create a planar compact dual band microstrip patch antenna. The design is investigated by making use of a single loop of meandered rectangular complementary split ring resonator (CSRR), which is etched in the ground plane of a conventional patch antenna, resulting in dual band behavior. The antenna is conceived on a Rogers Duroid 4350B substrate, which has relative permittivity of 3.66 and loss tangent 0.004. The patch antenna is designed to resonate at 5.65 GHz, whereas etching the proposed CSRRs in the ground plane creates another resonance at 3.65 GHz. Proposed design can be used for the Wireless local area network (WLAN) and Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave access (WiMAX) applications. The designed antenna has a compact size of 22 × 27 × 1.524 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: An Embedding of Secret Message in Audio Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The steganography is the embedding process of the secret message in the other carrier message. It carries the security, transparency and authenticity. The type of steganography is depends on the cover message used, if cover message used is audio to hide any type of data, it is audio steganography. The secret data hidden behind the audio can be image, audio or text. Audio steganography is more preferable because of the lots of redundancy. The different domains and methodologies are in exist for secret data embedding in audio signal. This paper gives the variety of algorithms to study the Audio Steganography.

articleTitle: High Frequency Analysis of GaAsP /InSb Hetero-Junction Double Gate Tunnel Field Effect Transistor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, we have presented a detailed study on a new Double Gate Tunnel Field-Effect Transistor for suppression of ambipolar behavior and improved high-frequency response. The proposed device Hetero Gate Oxide Hetero-Junction Dual Gate Tunnel Field Effect Transistor (HGO-HJ-DG-TFET) is based on heterojunction material and gate dielectric engineering. Heterojunction provides increment in the drain current (Ids) by decreasing the tunneling width at sourcechannel (S/C) junction and increase the width at drain-channel (D/C) junction. Further, implementation of high-k dielectric at S/C region helps to increases the electric field thus providing better controllability. Therefore, the performance of the proposed device gets better in terms of subthreshold slope, drain current, resistant to parasitic capacitance and high frequency parameters. The reliability of device in high-frequency applications is also studied with optimization of channel length and drain voltage. Hence, the overall performance of the HGO-HJ-DG-TFET is examined using Silvaco TCAD for better efficiency of the device.

articleTitle: Detection and Prevention of HIV AIDS Using Big Data Tool
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Big Data is an accumulation of data sets which are abundant and intricate in character. They comprise both structured and unstructured data that evolve abundant, so speedy they are not convenient by classical relational database systems or current analytical tools. Big Data Analytics is not linearly able to expand. It is a predefined schema. Big data analysis is the demanding one because it contains huge number of records. In today's world, the massive instruction about health care is to be prepared in order to recognize, diagnose, identify and prevent the various diseases. It is projected to develop a centralized patient monitoring system using big data. Health care is the conservation or advancement of health along the avoidance, interpretation and medical care of disorder, bad health, abuse, and other substantial and spiritual deterioration in mortal. One of the best areas where big data can be used to form an advance medical care. Medical care has the potential to reduce costs of treatment, predict outbreaks of epidemics, avoid preventable diseases and improve the quality of life in general. Average human lifespan is increasing along world population, which poses new challenges to today's treatment delivery methods. A disease is a particular abnormal condition that affects part or all of an organism not caused by external force and that consists of a disorder of a structure or function, usually serving as an evolutionary disadvantage. The study of disease is called pathology, which includes the study of cause. This paper mainly focuses on the prediction of disease like HIV/AIDS using R programming.

articleTitle: 3-Ph 2- Level VSI with Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper gives brief idea about design and development of SPWM's three-step voltage source inverter. PWM is mainly applied to many industrial applications in which good performance is required. The SPWM pulses is produced by comparing reference signal and carrier signal that is sinusoidal wave and triangular wave. When the amplitude of sine wave is greater than triangular wave then pulses starts produce to high and when amplitude of triangular signal is greater than sine signal then pulses will come to low. The output of SPWM is changed by changing modulation index, frequency. The inverter output with SPWM gives lower Total Harmonic Distortion.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Load for Test Bench Setup of Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper proposes the work on dynamic loading of the propulsion motor by coupling of two induction motors mechanically on a common shaft. It's becoming important to develop, test bench setups of electric vehicles at industrial as well as educational premises to have novel works on the same. For electric vehicle lab testing, the major issue is with emulating the road and dynamic loading conditions. One induction motor will act as driving motor while the second motor, which is mechanically coupled with first motor will act as load, so it will work in generating mode as induction generator (IG). By varying the load on IG the different driving conditions of EV can be tested. The driving motor is controlled here with the open loop V/ F control with six step voltage source inverter (VSI), which can be controlled also with DTC or SVPWM techniques. The whole topology and different loading conditions are developed in MATLAB/Simulink which are discussed at the end of literature.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Various Techniques on Handwriting Recognition and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Handwriting recognition is highly important for digitalizing important documents. Many problems arise while recognizing an individual's handwriting. The most important factor here is legibility of the writing. Legibility gets affected if the words are not straight enough to be understood by the computing systems. So, to recognize anyone's handwriting, skew in the characters should be removed first. Here in this paper, some techniques are discussed which are used for the recognition and analysis of handwritings. These techniques aids the process of digitalization of the documents and ease the further processing of the documents.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Land Surface Temperature with Changing Land-Use: Building a Climate ResilientSmart City
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Urbanization is an irrevocable process resulting in increase in impervious layer due to result of migration of people or the consolidation of peri-urban areas into the cities causing transformation of lung spaces into paved spaces. Ever since the industrial revolution and introduction of IT sector into Indian economy, the urban population has increased from 30% to 54<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> since 1950. People in search of better job opportunities, education, infrastructure and improved living standards tend to relocate themselves near the cityleads to increased urbanization. This is one of the major drivers in landscape dynamics which includes alteration in land use pattern within and in theperiphery of the city resulting in elevated temperature in urban areas and formation of urban heat island. Continuous increment in surface temperature is one of the major contributors of climatic changes across the globe. Land surface temperature (LST) of the earth is changingat a disquieting rate, causing fluctuation in seasonal and rainfall patternsaffecting the ecology of the region damaging the biodiversity, changing in crop patterns, etc. Various studies indicated a strong relation of changes in LST with the modification in land use patterns inferring that increased urbanization and mismanagement of land and resources is the root cause of global and local climate change. These modifications in land use and LST can be tracked using space borne sensors, thus, providing vital information about the specific pockets with highest changes. Kolkata is facing unprecedented urbanization and increased temperature fluctuations because of the development activities oriented towards economic growth of the city. In this study, Land use patterns were derived for last three decades and Land surface temperature was quantified. Results specifydensified urban growth within the city boundaries and increasing land surface temperature Results helped in understanding the responsible factors of change and will provide an insight about the regions, which has experienced the major changes. This will helping the decision makers to create and implement sustainable development policies.

articleTitle: Temperature and Power Control of Water Geyser Using Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Since water heating is a rudimentary task of our day-to-day life, it has been turned into efficacious technology through water geyser system. Water geyser is used for thermodynamically heating water above its normal temperature. Its usage incorporates in bathing, washing, cooking & many where. So to corroborate the public demand, the key challenge is to make the system more cheap but efficient, handy but less erroneous. To hold its performance as well as cost, we need to design such a system that will provide us with exactly how we expect it to be. In this paper, we documented such a system where we get a smart water geyser with the combination of electricity efficiency & intelligence. We analyzed how human body interacts to different temperature levels of water & the water heating system would serve according to the need of a person. We also prevented any undesired consequences that may occur due to overheating & less temperature resistant plumbing system. This system handled the outburst of pipes due to overheating. This new water heating system can also act as an intelligent device by making its own decision whether to keep boiling the water or not by sensing consumer's presence.

articleTitle: The Expected Value Defuzzification Method for Pentagonal Fuzzy Number to Solve a Carbon Cost Integrated Solid Transportation Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The main feature of this paper is to propose the reduction method for the pentagonal fuzzy number using the expected value criterion. In this regard, some theoretical development is proposed for the pentagonal fuzzy number. As an application to the proposed reduction method, a single objective carbon cost integrated solid transportation problem minimizing the transportation cost along with the emission cost is solved with the parameters are as the pentagonal fuzzy number. To validate the proposed reduction method an analysis is outlined with the existing expected value reduction methods (viz. triangular and trapezoidal fuzzy numbers). After defuzzified the pentagonal fuzzy parameters, the equivalent deterministic problem is solved using the LINGO optimization solver. Based on the obtained solution, some important managerial decisions are finalized.

articleTitle: Control of Mobile Robot Using Visual Feedback and Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A camera based wireless control of a mobile robot is designed & implemented in this paper which is suitable for indoor application. This system consists of a mobile robot (Fire Bird Nex Robot), Laptop as controller, camera as sensor and XBee (zigbee) for wireless communication. A Wireless camera is used to capture images of the environment in which mobile robot is located. Laptop (Matlab) process images and calculate current position & orientation of robot using color detection algorithm. Control signals are sent to robot via XBee modules to drive it to desired location. This whole system is realized & experimented in a lab environment. Experimental results are presented to move robot between two locations.

articleTitle: Planar Trapezoidal Monopole Antenna for TVWS CPE
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents design and simulation of a wide band antenna for Customer Premise Equipment (CPE) in the TV White Space (TVWS) spectrum band operating between 470 MHz-700 MHz. A printed planar monopole antenna configuration has been examined which provides larger bandwidth than a conventional wire monopole. Low cost FR4 substrate with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\varepsilon_{\mathbf{r}}=\pmb{4.4}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{tan}\delta =\pmb{0.02}$</tex> has been used to design the antenna. The antenna is fed by a microstrip line whose width is same as that of the base of the monopole antenna. The ground plane is etched on the other side of the substrate and it can extend up to the base of the trapezoid. Total volume of the antenna is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pmb{198.9}\ \mathbf{x}\ \pmb{150}\ \mathbf{x}\ \pmb{1.6}\ \mathbf{mm}$</tex>. The antenna shows an impedance bandwidth for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{VSWR} \leq 2$</tex> in the frequency range of 470 MHz-700 MHz. The gain of this antenna is between 2.44 dB to 3.36 dB in the entire band of operation. The radiation pattern is omnidirectional in both E and H-planes. Radiation and total efficiency of the designed planar trapezoidal monopole antenna is approximately 99 %.

articleTitle: 3-Φ Z-Source PWM Controlled Solar Photovoltaic Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Single stage z-source PWM controlled transformerless PV system for the generation of three-phase electrical power is presented in this research paper. The number of power processing stages in the proposed topology is single, thus offers high reliability and less component count. The proposed system does not only boost the low photovoltaic voltage, but also tracks the available maximum power through solar photovoltaic array with the help of modelled MPPT charge controller. The conversion topology results have been verified in MATLAB Simulink. Thus proposed SPV multilevel inverter offers low line harmonic distortion, less cost as compared to available conventional multilevel inverter.

articleTitle: Quantum Supervised Clustering Algorithm for Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Supervised clustering is the process of grouping unlabeled objects by using some specific objectives and any supervised learning technique. In traditional clustering algorithms, the similarity measure is based on some distance finding formulations. In supervised clustering, this similarity measure is trained with the help of asupervised learning method. In this paper, we have designed a quantum supervised clustering algorithm and analyzed the overall runtime complexity of the algorithm. In our approach, we have trained the similarity measure model with quantum support vector machine. This quantum mechanically trained similarity measure model is used in the quantum K-Means algorithm, instead of the traditional distance-based similarity measure functions, for clustering unlabeled objects. Our analysis demonstrates that the proposed approach exhibits exponential speed up when compared to the classical implementation.

articleTitle: “Electronic Secure Vehicle Verification System Using Advanced Digi-Locker System”
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: All over the world, as per the Motor Vehicles Act of the respective countries, it is compulsory to that citizens always carry the original hard copy of documents like (Registration certificates book, vehicle pollution under control (PUC) certificate vehicle Insurance policy Many times citizens does not remember to carry the vehicle-related documents. When traffic police wanted to verify citizens documents at that time citizens need to carry these documents with them otherwise they need to face consequences. To overcome this problem, the proposed system will have a RTO cloud server, where all necessary documents of the vehicle (Vehicle pollution under control certificate, Registration certificate, and Insurance policy) are scanned and stored. The Quick Response code (QR Code) is Japanese fast readable technique which scans documents of the citizen's vehicle. The real-time android application will be used of QR code generator of citizen's documents and QR-code receiver for scanning purposes. The verifier authority (Traffic police) will scan a unique QR Code generator for user mobility. In proposed system whenever citizen's documents get expired at that time it will send notification alert. This system will help in saving a significant amount of time. To avoid intrusion of citizens original documents, so noisy QR-code will be used to provide privacy.

Author Keywords: user's/ Citizens and verifier Authority (Traffic police) application

articleTitle: A New Decoding Logic for Quadrature Encoder Interfacing for Software Implementation on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for decoding the signals from the input channels of the encoder into determining the states and the changes of the encoder input from one state to another. Since it is a quadrature encoder it has specific states related to encoder position and the changes of states from one specific state to another will give the direction of rotation. A present state-past state table has been constructed based on the inputs of the encoder and a logic function has been developed. The program will evaluate that equation and determine the direction of the rotation as well as to count the number of times the states of the input has changed to get the estimated amount of rotation. The simulation results are provided in this paper.

articleTitle: A Study on Information Security Situation Modelling
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the advent of digitization and new technologies, organizational information security has become a major concern. As information elements are spreading across the world, there comes the threat to security of information. Enterprises are investing pretty good amount in taking various measures for securing their information. The most important step for securing the information is about knowing current situation of information security of organization. Knowing situation requires some kind of evaluation method. The evaluation of security situation is currently the qualitative analysis. The aim of the evaluation is to help the decision maker to percept the security situation quickly and correctly. In this paper, it is attempted to put this measurement and prediction of security (or evaluation of security) quantitatively. This quantitative method of evaluation of situation has few advantages over qualitative method. First advantage is transparency, less human intervention., possibility of benchmarking and second is possibility of computer automation of measurement method. Quantitative model of information security situation (QMISS) is described in section-2 of paper. This model is based on much known tenets of information security. This QMISS model further can be used for predicting and computing current value of security situation (VSS). QMISS has several components. Out of these components., in this paper., prediction part is done only for one component that is information security incidents (lSI).ISI can be thought most important parameter while evaluating organizational security situation. Neural network is used while establishing prediction mechanism for parameter ISI., described in section 3. Thus in this paper., mainly two work is done. First quantitative model for security situation QMISS is proposed and second Neural Net (NN) based prediction mechanism is described for information security incidents (ISI). With above predicted number of ISIs and knowledge of other parameter of QMISS., VSS can be computed. With VSS., one can benchmark one's organization's security situation. On this basis., security-head can take suitable actions on improvement of VSS of her organization.

articleTitle: On-Demand Data Transmission in Multi-Hop Cluster in Underwater Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Day to day under water sensor network is becoming a key challenge. The under water environment is not suitable. The nodes are deployed in hostile and human inaccessible area. Maintaining the nodes and energy consumption is the important parameter to be considered. In the Reliability point, of view energy consumption should be very less. To achieve this less energy consumption, we have proposed a method. In this proposed method, the sensed data are stored in the input queue of the sensor devices and transmitted to the Cluster Head (CH), only at the time of requirement. Thereby, save the data transmission energy and also the receiving energy. As compared to frequent data transmission and selective data transmission, we have saved approximately 2% of consumed energy using this proposed method.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of a Photoplethysmographic Biosensor Using Efficient Signal Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The Photoplethysmographic Biosensors can be used to monitor various physiological parameters like arterial oxygen saturation, glucose level in the blood, heart rate, blood pressure etc. But the Photoplethysmographic signals could be contaminated by various noise sources. The performance limitation due to the motion artifacts is very high compared to that due to other noise sources. Conventional filtering techniques are incapable to get rid of motion artifacts effectively and completely due to the frequency overlapping between the motion artifacts and the clean Photoplethysmographic signal. This work focuses on the performance enhancement of the Photoplethysmographic Biosensor by removing the effect of motion artifacts caused by the voluntary movements of the individual. The obj ective was achieved by developing an algorithm which is capable of providing motion artifact-free Photoplethysmographic signal during various physical activities of an individual without compromising any signal characteristics. We have developed three motion artifact removal algorithms: Butterworth-Wavelet Algorithm, Adaptive Normalized Least Mean Square Algorithm and Adaptive Recursive Least Square Algorithm. The three algorithms were performed on hundred samples collected from twenty-five subj ects under four fingertip movements like shivering, vertical movement, horizontal movement and applying pressure. Based on the SNR analysis, Butterworth-Wavelet Algorithm was found better in providing high SNR.

Author Keywords: Adaptive Normalized Least Mean Square Algorithm

articleTitle: Color Image Steganography Using Random Key Matrix
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The proposed steganographic technique is for the space domain steganography. The pixel value of cover image is changed to odd or even value according to the incoming bit. The proposed algorithm can store one data bit in one pixel of the cover image. Here, along with the data hiding, security is provided by the proposed Random Key Matrix (RKM). Different pixel values of the steganographic image are re-arranged according to the different elements of the secret Random Key Matrix (RKM). The proposed data embedding algorithm ensures a high visual steganographic image with added layers of security. Results show that with the proposed algorithm high Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) value is obtained with less mean square error value.

articleTitle: Centralized Framework for Workload Distribution in Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Fog computing is a platform for executing computation intensive tasks by aggregating computational resources of the edge-devices. The challenges of fog computing, includes heterogeneity, scalability, addressing and security. In this paper, we address the workload distribution problem in fog network. This is particularly important for reducing the computational latency of an offtoading task. An efficient workload distribution is required for effective resource utilization of the fog network. The two extreme approaches for solving the workload distribution problem is by utilizing a centralized or a distributed approach. A distributive framework can be scalable and fault tolerant. However, the communication overhead for maintaining a distributed framework is significantly more compared to a centralized approach. On the other hand, a centralized framework, can be relatively easier for implementing an economic model for multiple services offered by the system. In this paper, we investigate the feasibility of implementing a centralized framework to handle workload distribution in fog network.
