The two main entities of the framework are: Controller, that collects the available network resources of the participating devices for efficient workload distribution and Clients, providing computational resources for executing task. We evaluate our framework by integrating various heterogeneous nodes like DragonBoard, RaspberryPi and others.

articleTitle: Capacity Value Estimation of Renewable Energy in Maharashtra Using Peak Period Method
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper deals with calculation of capacity value of renewable energy (solar and wind energy) in Maharashtra state of India. Capacity value refers to the contribution of a power plant to reliably meet peak power demand. This implies that if a 150 MW solar plant has a capacity value of 50%, it can contribute 75 MW of power to reliably meet demand, and thus reduce the strain on conventional power generation plants. The capacity value calculations involve the comparison of hourly capacity factor of the grid connected renewable energy plants in the state, with the state's hourly demand met, and hence provide an understanding of the contribution of renewable energy towards meeting system reliability. In this paper, the capacity value has been calculated for different districts in Maharashtra with respect to the state's hourly demand data. Four districts are considered for wind energy estimation and six districts are considered for solar energy estimation. The results of all districts considered in this analysis have been combined and showcased at the state level. Capacity value calculations have been done for solar system, wind system, as well as a combined solar and wind system at the state level.

articleTitle: Implementation of DC Motor Speed Control Logic on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, we aim to design a system which can automate the speed control process and allow more accurate control of speed of the DC motor. It is used for speed control of motors of different voltage ratings. We aim to do this by implementing a Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) Controller designed on a FPGA. By fixing the duty cycle, motors of different ratings can be controlled using the same circuit. This system will be capable of adapting to the changes in desired speed in real time. It is designed in such a way that it adapts to dynamic changes in the load on the motor shaft. Using, this method we can accurately achieve the required output voltage across the motor to drive the motor at required speed and the need for an external starter circuit to start the motor without causing any damage to the control circuit is eliminated.

articleTitle: Effect of Different Signal Processing Techniques on a Calibration Free Pulse Oximeter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A pulse oximeter is a medical device that measures pulse rate and oxygen saturation levels of a person non-invasively. Monitoring of health parameters of a patient requires a device that gives accurate results in all conditions and is not affected by artifacts arising from environmental and physiological factors. One of the noise factors we focus in this paper is motion artifacts. These artifacts affect the quality of signal acquired by the sensor leading to imperfect results. In this paper, four digital filtering techniques, which include Exponential Moving Averaging, Savitzky-Golay, Independent Component Analysis and Discrete Kalman filter, are implemented to remove artifacts from a noisy photoplethysmographic signal acquired by shining lights in the range of Red and IR wavelengths on the fingertip of a person. Pulse rate is determined in the time domain by detecting peaks of the signal while blood oxygen levels are measured using Beer-Lambert Law via a calibration-free method on the artifact-free PPG signal. The results obtained are then compared with a commercial pulse oximeter available in the market and performance of different filtering techniques on a PPG signal is evaluated.

articleTitle: Dielectric Relaxation Phenomena of Aniline and Substituted Anilines with Acetonitrile Under 9.36 GHz Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Relaxation times τ and τ due to whole molecular rotation and the flexible parts of the dilute binary (jk) polar solution of three amine(j) and acetonitrile(k) in C6H6 at 30°C are estimated using susceptibility measurement technique under 9.36 GHz electric field. The increasing values of τ signify the increasing acidity of amine (proton donor) in complex systems. But in nitriles with N, N-dimethyl amine systems, the τ values are less than the other amine complexes due to steric hindrance and inductive effect.. The measured relaxation time (τ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">'</sup> s) and dipole moment (\pmbμ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">'</sup>s) match well with the reported values establishing the utility of the proposed method. Solute-solvent and solute-solute molecular associations are ascertained in various molecular environments due to different electron affinity of adjacent atoms. Thermodynamic energy parameters are calculated using Eyring rate theory to predict the molecular dynamics of the system.

articleTitle: Text to Image Encryption Using 16*16 Playfair Cipher and Dynamic Color Channel Selection Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: There are many encryption techniques. But almost all of these Encryption techniques work as a combination of substitution and transposition. They are usually text to text as this saves memory. We propose a method of encryption for environments where memory is not an issue but security is. In this paper we cover how one can do a basic playfair cipher and then encapsulate the cipher text hence into an RGB image. Where R, G, B, each are channels. These channels will be where the cipher text will be put in to create an image. Hence encapsulating the data.

articleTitle: Melanoma Screening Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Deep learning algorithms, in particular convolutional neural networks, have rapidly become a methodology of choice for analyzing images. This choice arises due to fact that Deep Learning reduces the feature engineering task which is very important for automatic analysis of various kinds of images including medical images. In this work we have implemented various Deep Convolutional Neural Networks architectures for the process of binary classification task efficient enough in predicting either the input RGB image of the skin lesion is melanoma or not. Diagnosing the skin lesion is the first step towards its treatment. In this work we have assimilated two approaches on the pretrained Convolutional Neural Networks on the ImageNet dataset. Firstly, we use the transfer learning approach without any fine tuning and obtained features are fed for linear classification task. Secondly, we use the transfer learning approach with fine tuning. The adopted method requires no lesion segmentation or any other higher level image processing tasks. Finally, we have also developed a real time android application to perform the binary classification task. The result obtained using our android application were enthusiastic.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machines for Protein Family Identification Using Surface Invariant Coordinates
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Identification of protein family or classification of proteins is one of the trying and important problems in bioinformatics and modern day biology. It's important to determine the family of a protein because of sheer importance of proteins in our life. In the past many methods based on the structure and sequence composition of proteins have been developed to classify proteins and to determine the family of proteins. But no work has been done in this regard by taking into account the roughness of the protein surfaces. Here we demonstrate a method using support vector machines and exploiting the surface roughness of the protein to identify the family of a protein. This method can also be used to classify proteins into different families.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Extricating Information from Speckle Noise Corrupted Color Brain MRI Images Using Morphological Enhancement Followed by Watershed and Region Growing Based Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Segmentation of an image is performed to extricate desired information for analysis. Brain MRI images require segmentation for extricating useful information for detecting tumors and disease related to white matter like multiple sclerosis for diagnosis of disease. The segmentation methodology may be adversely affected when performed on images affected with noise. This paper offers a novel approach for segmentation of speckle noise corrupted brain MRI images using noise filtering, enhancement using morphology, watershed transform followed by region growing technique for information extraction. The proposed method provides finer results as compared to mean shift and K means color image segmentation techniques as well as fuzzy c means clustering with improved robustness.

articleTitle: Development of Automation Test Suites for Validating GNSS Software
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper is for understanding the GNSS System architecture, test procedure for GNSS and developing an application to control the GNSS hardware. GNSS (Global Navigation Satelite System) refers to a constellation of satelites providing signals from space transmitting positioning data encoded in the form of signals. There are six major constellations currently available in as per GNSS technology. These are GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO, BIEDOU, NAVIK and QZSS. To simulate these constellations, we can use Roof Antenna which provides desired radio frequency. The entire performance of GNSS product depends on Signal to Noise ratio and TTFF (Time To First Fix). The application is developed to trigger the tests for checking the performance of GNSS hardware by taking the inputs from the user and to populate the location data results in tabular view dynamically, to pinpoint the obtained locations in a Map and also to populate the obtained SNR values in a bar-chart. GNSS Test Application is a tool to execute various test cases and check the reliability of GNSS product. This application is written in C++. Gnss Command Line executable is developed with new features like start positioning session, stop session and resetting the GNSS Hardware. This CLI is written in C++.

articleTitle: Data Sensing and Resource Scheduling in Clustered Environment for Post Disaster Management Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A disaster is a catastrophe that can be either natural or caused by mankind. Disasters often lead to permanent changes in human societies, ecosystems and the surrounding environment. With respect to post disaster, its very necessary to take quick in-time decision to reduce number of fatalities. In this regard, real time data sensing and resource scheduling is important to prevent such a huge loss. Hence, in this paper we focus on Internet based real time data sensing in clustered environment for effective sensing and scheduling. Data are processed on Raspberry pi-3 which act as web server and we have used MTS400 CC sensor which is mounted on IRIS mote. For visualization we have implemented android application which is integrated with Google map.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of CSA Optimized PIDF Controller for Containing Frequency Fluctuation of Micro-Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Integration of renewable power generation in the modern power system requires intelligent and flexible control to ensure the balance between the generation and load demand. This paper addresses a frequency control model of an isolated micro-grid with plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (EV) and heat pump (HP) supplied by diesel engine generator (DEG) and renewable solar thermal power generation (STPG). Due to the interconnection of intermittent energy source like STPG and load variation, the micro-grid frequency fluctuate with different adverse effect on the power system. The PID and PID with filter (PIDF) are employed with EV, DEG and HP to control their power generation to maintain the desired frequency level under different contingencies. The parameters of PID and PIDF controllers are controllably tuned by Cuckoo search algorithm (CSA) for containing frequency fluctuation and their performances are compared thereafter. Different disturbed conditions have been realized in the form of step perturbations and random variations on the load and generation side. Investigation of the responses shows that Cuckoo search algorithm (CSA) based PIDF controller gives better response compare to the Cuckoo search algorithm (CSA) based PID controller.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Carbon Nanotube Field Effect Transistor Based Digital Circuits
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the performance of CNTFET to check how capable it is, as a future alternative of CMOS technology. Several circuits are simulated which includes 4-to-2 bit Priority Encoder, Full Adder and Full Subtractor using CNTFET HSPICE model and whole process is repeated for CMOS HSPICE model, where CMOS model is used as reference, chosen because it is the existing technology. The main parameter adopted for comparison is Power-Delay Product. Values from the model of CMOS are compared to CNTFET model to check for the suitability of CNTFET as the future of transistor industry. Through the use of simulated results obtained, the work quantitatively shows how promising CNTFET can be, as it exhibits very good Power-Delay Product (PDP) characteristics compared to CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Myoelectric Controlled Thumb
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Our human fingers are provided specific roles which finally results into various hand motions and functions. The thumb plays a special role because it takes part in several activities. So, a thumb loss because of traumatic accidents or other reasons can prove terrible because appropriate functions of the hand will get sternly restricted. Prosthetic thumb is developed, for solving this problem, and to be worn to counterpart functions of the lost thumb. The control strategy of the prosthetic part is completely based on the surface electromyogram (sEMG) signals to control it. This paper uses the electrical activity of the muscles (EMG) as control signals in a pattern recognition control system. The paper proposes a system for pattern recognition of EMG signals using MATLAB and ANN.

articleTitle: Compressive Sensing and Recovery of Image Using Uniform Block Sparsity
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a method for compressive sensing and recovery of gray image from the samples has been proposed. To achieve this, the concept of image partitioning (Block Processing) with compressive sensing has been used. The proposed method reduces the computational complexity of the algorithm. Further, the computational time required by the proposed method is 1/9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>of the time achieved by the conventional method and can be further decreased by parallel processing.

articleTitle: Stand-Alone Batteryless Water Pumping System Using Single Phase Boost Inverter Fed Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A vast part of rural India is still deprived of electrical grids and with all efforts of the government it is still a far cry to get every Indian village grid connectivity. With the advent of PV cells and aided technology it is possible to provide off grid stand alone systems for the electrical energy requirement of villages still disconnected from grid in India. In the present work a battery less PV system employing single stage DC to AC conversion from PV to drive water pumping system is proposed. Present work explains working of a single phase induction motor driving a centrifugal water pump fed from a battery less PV by a single phase boost inverter.

articleTitle: Advanced Security System for Car
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this modern world, safety and security is becoming a very complex issue, especially in case of vehicles which are parking in common places had become a very big complex issue. But this project deals with the design and implementation of an additional advanced car security system for car, which is achieved by using an embedded system integrated with a spy camera inside the car and fed with the input of the sensors to it and which are connected to all doors of the cars. If the car door is unlawfully opened or the car is snooped by a thief, then the spy camera will tilt to that side immediately and captures the culprits face and that footage will be saved in database and it will be sent a mail to users email id, so finally the user can complain to police with the evidence of that footage. By this system we will be able to know the culprit who tries to steal our car and further data is being uploaded to cloud for further development where if a particular area is having this type complaints more then by using this system we can finally reduce the crime level.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Prediction of Life of Arteriovenous Fistula
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Millions of patients worldwide suffer from Kidney failure and require dialysis. In most cases, dialysis is started after the kidney function of the patient falls below a threshold. In this scenario the patients kidney is essentially non functional. In order to conduct dialysis, native arteriovenous fistulas are constructed to increase blood flow in the superficial vein, and hence facilitate dialysis. Over time, as dialysis continues, the patient may suffer from hypertension and reduced vein function leading to the collapse of the fistula. The ultrasound doppler test for checking the state of the fistula are expensive and doing it again and again is not feasible. We study work related to Chronic Kidney Disease which provides similar data points to those required for the health of the fistula and propose a mechanism to predict the life of a fistula.

articleTitle: DSP BasedSecond Order Sliding Mode Controller for Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: DC-DC Converters are used in effective conversion of the unregulated input voltages to regulated output voltages. Sliding mode control technique is one of the methods used to achieve smooth and robust voltage control. The first order sliding mode control method regulates the output voltage to the desired value but suffers from the phenomena called chattering. Chattering reduces the life of the converter switch. Various methods such as boundary layer control, higher order sliding mode control etc. can be used to reduce this chattering effect. Boundary layer control uses continuous approximation of the discontinuous control signal to reduce chattering. However it reduces the speed of response and introduces steady state error. Chattering can be effectively reduced by using higher order sliding mode control. In this paper, Second order Sliding mode controller is implemented by using the Super-Twisting Algorithm. Results for the second order control are compared with the first order control with and without boundary layer control and effectiveness is verified. Hardware prototype is developed using Microcontroller Piccolo C2000 TMS320F28069 Launchpad and the results are analyzed for robustness by varying the input voltage.

articleTitle: Comparison of Pixel N-Grams with Histogram, Haralick's features and Bag-of-Visual-Words for Texture Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Texture image classification is very useful in many domains. It has been tried using statistical., spectral and structural approaches. A novel Pixel N-grams technique has emerged for image feature extraction recently. The aim of this paper is to analyse the efficacy of Pixel N-grams technique for texture image classification in comparison with the traditional techniques namely Intensity histogram., Haralick's features based on co-occurrence matrix and state-of-the-art Bag-of-Visual-Words (BoVW). The experiments were carried out on the benchmark UIUC texture dataset using SVM classifier. The classification performance was compared using Fscore., Recall and Precision. The classification results using Pixel N-gram were significantly better than that using Intensity histogram and Haralick features whereas., they were comparable with the BoVwapproach.

articleTitle: Miniaturization of Logarithmic Spiral Antenna Using Fibonacci Sequence and Koch Fractals
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper discusses recently reported Fibonacci spiral and Koch fractals to reduce the footprint of a logarithmic spiral antenna (LSA). The Fibonacci spiral has been used to approximate the two continuous peripheries of logarithmic spiral. The inherent quarter circular sections of Fibonacci spiral form the discontinuous base for fractals to be superimposed upon. 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> iterations of Koch curve have provided 23.1% and 48.3% of miniaturization respectively as compared to logarithmic spiral antenna with size of \pmb78×50mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">\pmb2</sup>. These antennas without backing work efficiently in the frequency band of 2 GHz to 12 GHz with average gain of 5 dB and 98.7% of radiation efficiency. They radiate bidirectional beam of circularly polarized nature when excited with unbalanced feed.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Resource Provisioning in Cloud Using Load Comfort Index and VM Demand: A Preview
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Organizations as well as Individuals are now-a-days moving to the Cloud due to advantages such as Resource Availability at cheaper rates, Maintenance free Infrastructure, Most Recent updated applications, Anywhere and anytime resource provisioning, Ubiquitous Networking, etc. However there are drawbacks associated with the advantages such as High Power Consumption, Hidden Datacenter Location, Security, Allotment of Resources and Partial Load on Hosts. So, to solve some of these problems in this paperwe aim to address a burning issue of resource allotment to consumer based on novel approach of resource indexing has been proposed. Proposed scheme not only reduce energy consumption but also overcome the issue of poor resource provisioning. Here in this approach, the incoming user requests will be consider based on parameters like whether process is critical or not, required partial resource or full allotment Etc. The system not only support better resource allotment but also provides more energy efficient environment to Cloud providers.

articleTitle: Real Time Simulation of Distribution Statcom
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Power factor is an important parameter in the distribution power systems. In the recent days a lot of priority is given to the improvement of power factor. The main aim of this paper is to improve the power factor by utilizing a controlled Distribution STATCOM. A real time electrical network of the distribution load of Chandragunda village, Warangal district, Telangana is considered. The power factor at the real time load is observed to be declining due to the inductive nature of the motors connected in the village. Therefore to improve power factor at load end Pole Mounted controlled D-STATCOM is connected. A modified instantaneous symmetrical component theory is used to generate the reference currents to control the reactive power. The Hysteresis current control technique is used to control the D-STATCOM. The achieved result indicates that the D-STATCOM compensator improves the power factor.

articleTitle: Resource Monitoring and Scheduling for Post Disaster Management Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Internet based information and communication technology can serve as a catalyst in saving many people lives during disaster situations. Disasters affect not only the wellbeing of family groups and individuals, but also the welfare of communities. In this regard, effective manner of monitoring and scheduling the resources in real time is very essential in post disaster management. Various tasks in a network typically assigned to perform operations such as rescuing and recovering the injured people and gather the information in and around the disaster places which is critical. The data and information, thus acquired, needs to be disseminated for effective scheduling of different resources that are available in such networks. Therefore, Internet based resource monitoring in real time has become an aid for various applications. In this context, for efficient visualization of resource monitoring and scheduling is addressed in this paper using modified banker's algorithm. Effective utilization of the available resources and scheduling them in the most required places of disaster is implemented in android based application and integrated with Google map based web service.

articleTitle: Dynamic Voltage Restorer Based on H Bridge Inverter with Non-Linear load
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Dynamic voltage restorer i.e. DVR is a device used in a power industry to protect the sensitive loads from damaging or misbehaving. Voltage sag and voltage swell, transients are the causes of fault in the system. In this paper simulation results were obtained for both sags and swell by using the DVR device which can be used as a compensating device. DVR is inserted into the system through insertion transformer which can provide the voltage of required magnitude and phase angle into the system. Sag and Swell were conditions taken in the simulation at different intervals. Now we can see the how the DVR behaves during such conditions.

articleTitle: Portable Wireless Multipurpose Signal Viewer, Analyzer and Generator Using ATMEGA328P MCU and Android
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The conventional oscilloscopes and signal generators are bulky and expensive. What we propose is a cheap portable alternative to this using the ATMEGA328P micro controller and Android. The idea is to detect the signals using the analog to digital converters in the micro controller and transmit them over to an android device over Blue Tooth, which views the waveform using the developed application. The micro controller also produces signals using digital to analog converters in it, after receiving the corresponding commands from the above mentioned application. The prototype implemented can sense and generate signals up to a maximum voltage of 5 volts. The proposed solution can serve as a pocket sized and affordable substitute to existing oscilloscopes and signal generators for almost all applications, where high accuracy is not mandatory.

Author Keywords: Multipurpose signal viewer analyzer and generator
Cheap portable oscilloscope and signal generator
Oscilloscope and signal generator using ATMEGA328P micro controller and android
Oscilloscope and signal generator for electronics enthusiasts

articleTitle: Multi Lead Fetal QRS Detection with Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Noninvasive fetal monitoring can prove as an efficient tool to supervise cardiac health of fetus during pregnancy. This paper presents a work related to fetal QRS detection by single and multi-lead methods. The work is result of participation in Physionet challenge 2013. One single lead and two multi lead approaches are implemented and discussed. Results of the three different approaches are compared. First approach is a single lead which detects fetal QRS on each of the input signal separately while other two are multi lead which makes use of Principal Component Analysis (PCA), at different stages. Performances of the methods are evaluated in terms of sensitivity, positive predictivity and error detection rate. Average Sensitivity is 95 % for single lead approach while 90 and 89 % for the multi-lead approaches. Average Positive predictivity is 98 % for all three approaches. Error detection rate is 7 for first, and 14 % and 15 % for the multi lead methods. Performance of the single lead method is superior compare to the PCA based multi lead method.

articleTitle: Use of Image Processing in Lane Departure Warning System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Lane departure warning system is a method which assists a driver and also provides extreme care while car starts to move out of the lane by imparting adaptive cruise control which facilitates in detecting blind spot and providing significantly greater lane divergence warning using image processing. Multilevel fuzzy edge detection algorithm accomplishes improved efficiency and also provides exact detection of lane markings on roads even if there's fading of markings as years pass by. Precision of the device has been discovered to boost extremely by including a strategy that has been provided in this specific paper. It is different out of the conventional edge detection algorithm to identify the lane markings on streets and thereby aid the driver. This particular technique has created a refined and an accurate method which assists the driver with the aid of that type of lane departure warning system. Multitudinous parameters on the highways such as the dimensions of the lane markings, its distance and location from a specific reference point could be captured as well as recognized by several techniques making use of this algorithm which makes use of few image enhancement methodologies.

articleTitle: A Dual Band Circularly Polarized Y-ShapedPatch Antenna for Wireless Communication Application
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This study related to a Dual-band circularly-polarized (CP) micro strip patch antenna layout consisting of a single Y-shaped patch with rectangular ground plane fed by microstrip transmission line. This configuration is considered for bandwidth enhancement. A rectangle have been etched from the upper periphery of the ground to enhance the impedance bandwidth (IBW). In order to enhance the axial ratio bandwidth (ARBW) by a significant amount proper dimension of V-shaped has been used. By using this structure the achievable IBW and center frequency (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>) are 5.557 GHz ( i.e. 4.933 GHz - 10.49 GHz, 72.05 %) and7.7 GHz respectively. The correspondingARBW are 742.5 MHz (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> 6.32 GHz, 11.75 %) and 1091.8 MHz (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> 8.32 GHz, 13.12%). The maximum simulated peak gain is 3.19 dBi at 8.64 GHz within the CP band. Proposed antenna happens to be suitable for `C' and `X' band wireless communication application.

articleTitle: Remote Triggered Digital System Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), Govt. of India took the initiative of Remote Triggered Digital System Laboratory under the National Mission on Education through Information and Communication Technology (NME-ICT). This virtual laboratory provides the theoretical understanding of digital electronics to the students by performing various experiments.

articleTitle: Analysis of Grading Induced Bandgap Variability and Defect States on Performance of CIGS Solar Cells Through Device Simulations
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Grading of the band gap through the CIGS absorber layer has potential to improve the efficiency of the solar cell and the CIGS material has a feature of adjustable band gap. Therefore taking the advantage of that we varied the band gap of the CIGS material by changing the composition ratio of Ga/(Ga+In) and S/(S+Se). We simulated and analyzed the effect of band gap variations in CIGS layer, induced by grading of doping concentration profile and defect states over the performance of solar cell. The performance analysis was done using S CAPS-ID simulator. We found that the variable band gap in absorber layer provides an alternative to reduce the absorber layer thickness and yet achieve the comparable efficiency of the device. We observed the 2.48% efficiency increment by grading the CIGS material. This enhancement in efficiency is because of reduced recombination effect and increased no of generating excitons.

articleTitle: New Approach in Big Data Mining for Frequent Itemset Using Mapreduce in HDFS
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: To find out the frequent itemset is very important task in data mining. These frequent itemsets are useful in applications like Association rule mining and co-relations. To extract frequent itemsets these systems are using some algorithms, but these are inefficient in distributing and balancing the load, when it comes across excessive data. Automatic parallelization is also not possible with these algorithms. To overcome these issues of existing algorithms there is need to develop algorithm which will support the missing features, such as automatically parallelization, balancing and good distribution of data. In this paper we are using a new approach to find out frequent itemsets by using MapReduce. Modified Apriori algorithm is used with HDFS environment this is called FiDoop Technique. In this technique mapreduce process will work independently and concurrently by using the decompose strategy. The result of this mapreduce technique will be given to the reducers and reducers will show the result. In the experiment we used three different algorithms like basic apriori, FP Growth and our proposed modifies apriori, the system has executed in standalone machine as well as distributed environment and shown the results how proposed algorithm is better than existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Implementation of Feedback Monitoring System for Canteen Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: To device embedded module for standalone operation of collecting and monitoring a feedback about the refreshment canteen from the users during the peak hours. This paper discusses the implementation of micro controller based feedback monitoring system which connects web server via the Internet using the wireless network. I.e. Proposed system would be based on IoT platform.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security of Electronic Patient Record with Tamper Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: As the use of internet is increasing everything is available at home on just finger tips. Medical field cannot stay behind in these advancements. But there are lot of security threats and risks involved in sharing medical data. Providing security to patient's record is first responsibility of any medical organization. This paper focuses on medical image security with tamper detection. Security to a system is achieved by first encrypting the Electronic Patient Record by DNA cryptography. Then encrypted cypher text is given to verifiable secret sharing algorithm. These shares are distributed to participants. When they will combine the shares, secret can be revealed. The changes or modifications in the shares are detected using verifiability of shares. The results of technique are compared on the basis of performance parameters such as MSE and PSNR.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Study for Selection of Proper IIR Filter: Specifications Dependant Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Filters are greatly used in signal processing and telecommunication engineering to eliminate the unwanted part of the signal i.e. noise. In modern years, filters are used in mobile communication for reducing the speech echo or in biomedical test (like Electrocardiogram, EEG etc.) to reduce the noise associated with the signal. Filters can be classified in two broad domains-Analog and Digital. The hierarchy involved in digital filters are further divided into two types-Infinite Impulse Response (IIR) and Finite Impulse Response (FIR). IIR filter are known for their infinite impulse response, there are various specification upon which the design depends, and all the techniques are used in different types of filter design. In this paper we have described the three main IIR filters i.e. Butterworth filter, Chebyshev Type I, Chebyshev Type-II. As the number of specifications are large, we should have a proper way to determine a specific filter for a particular application. In order to find the best suited filter, a specification dependent approach has been discussed which compares the parameters with respect to passband ripple, stopband attenuation, order of the filter and slope. and outputs the best filter suitable for a specific application. All the simulations have been carried out using MATLAB 2015-a and the algorithm has been coded using Python - high level programming language.

articleTitle: An Innovative Transient Free Adaptive SVC for Reactive Power Compensation and PF Correction Using ARM Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A case study is carried out on 1 KV A, 50 Hz distribution transformers. An innovative transient free adaptive static V AR compensator is designed and developed. An ARM is used to carry out process development which helps in automatic reactive power compensation in addition to power factor correction. The static voltage compensation (SVC) needs to use capacitor bank in many series and parallel combination in addition to star and delta connections. These capacitors are considered as step increment rather than fractional increment due to availability of capacitors in the market.

articleTitle: Hexagonal Shaped Magnetically Coupled EBG for X-Band Antenna Bandwidth Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents a hexagonal shaped resonator modified into a EBG structure. Using the proposed structure, an attempt has been made to improve the bandwidth of patch antenna as well as radiation efficiency. This work elucidates a Patch Antenna loaded with a hexagonal shaped split ring resonator magnetically coupled into an EBG structure. The antenna is made reconfigurable using two `L' shaped slots. The said antenna and the metamaterial design has been evaluated for its performance with an antenna load. The Metamaterial loaded antenna improves the bandwidth by 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> (3 times) as well as radiation efficiency by a percentage of 3.54%.

articleTitle: Wind Farm Connected Distribution System Protection Using Wavelet-Alienation Coefficient Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper deals with an algorithm, based on wavelet-Alienation coefficients for protection of wind farm connected distribution network. The proposed algorithm takes the differential current signal of grid node and wind farm coupling node. The Wavelet transform used to extract the approximation coefficients of all the three-phase current signals. Alienation coefficients of each differential phase current obtained over a half cycle is used to identify and categorize the various faults. A modified IEEE13 bus test feeder system used for simulation in MATLAB. Proposed technique tested for detection of all shunt faults at each bus of the distribution system.

articleTitle: Survey on Fault Tolerance and Security in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs)
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Providing fault tolerance in Mobile Ad hoc Networks (MANETs) is very tricky activity as nodes migrate from one place to other place and changes network topology. Also MANET is very susceptible for various attacks like DoS attacks etc. So providing security to MANET is also very difficult job. Multipath protocols provide better results than unipath protocols. Multipath protocols provide fault tolerance but many multipath protocols for MANETs not targeted security issues. Distributed and cooperative security that means Intrusion Detection System (IDS) gives better security to MANETs. In this paper we have discussed many confronts and concerns regarding fault tolerance and IDS.

Author Keywords: IDS for Mobile Ad hoc Networks

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Position Estimator Algorithm on Voice Coil Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Voice Coil Motors (VCMs) have been an inevitable element in the mechanisms that have been used for precise positioning in the applications like 3D printing., micro-stereolithography., etc. These voice coil motors translate in a linear direction and require a high accuracy position sensor that amounts for a major part in the budget. In this research work., an effort has been made to design and implement an algorithm that would predict the displacement of VCM and eliminate the need of high cost sensors. VCM was integrated with dSPACE DS1104 R&D controller via linear current amplifier (LCAM) which acts as a driver circuit for VCM. Sine input was given to VCM with various amplitude and frequency and the corresponding displacement is measured by using linear variable differential transformer (LVDT). The position estimator algorithm is also implemented at the same time on VCM and its output is compared with that of LVDT. It is observed that there is 97.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> accuracy in between algorithm output and LVDT output. Further., PID controller is used in integration with the novel algorithm to minimize the error. The estimator algorithm is tested for various amplitudes and frequencies and it is found that it has a very good agreement of 99.2% with the actual displacement measured with the help of LVDT.

articleTitle: Voltage Distortion at Distribution Side Reduced by Modified UPQC
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Today power system demand is increasing. In recent year power degraded at distribution side. Power loss is increasing at consumer side due to more uses of non-linear load. Power quality issues created by sensitive load. In this paper modified UPQC device used for reduce voltage distortion. This FACT device helps to improve power quality it become reliable electricity. On the load side, the voltage and current distortion increase when the power decreases. It badly affected on power factor. A unified power quality conditioner (UPQC) used to reduce problems related to voltage and current. The active power filter(APF) are used make distortion free current also voltage. UPQC has Series APF and shunt APF which are simultaneously acting. Series APF work for balancing voltage and shunt APF work for balancing current at load side. In this topology, three leg voltage source inverter (VSI) is used to avoid switching losses. Two VSI connected back to back. UPQC avoid voltage sag or swell, harmonics at load side. It Compensates current and voltage as per requirement at distribution side. It conducted two operations at a time so it's advantageous. In this paper Simulation study carried out with MATLAB 2016a.

articleTitle: Exploring the Utility of Graphene as Window Layer Towards Efficiency Improvement in CIGS Solar Cells Using Numerical Simulations
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Graphene has a huge potential to be utilized as the window layer material in CIGS solar cells owing to its excellent optical-electrical properties. In this work we explore the effect of incorporating graphene as window layer over the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of CIGS solar cell. The performance analysis was done by using SCAPS-1D. We observed that by optimizing the thickness of i-ZnO layer and the subsequent inclusion of graphene as window layer in place of ZnO:B layer the PCE of device rose to 13.32% which was 2.45% higher than that achieved without the incorporation of graphene layer. The observed enhancement in the PCE value upon graphene incorporation is attributed to the increased extent of quantum efficiency of the device in the UV region.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique for Fast Content-Based Image Retrieval Using Dual-Cross Patterns
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This proposed work introduces a novel technique for Fast Content-Based Image Retrieval (CBIR) using Dual-Cross Patterns (DCP). DCP encodes second order information in the vertical, horizontal and diagonal direction, by performing the encoding of sample points in the local surrounding region of every center pixel in an image. The local binary pattern (LBP), an efficient visual texture descriptor, performs a comparison between the center pixel and its neighboring pixel. Local tetra patterns (LTrP) is a method which acquires more detailed information by using four possible directions of every center pixel in an image, and is calculated from first-order derivatives in horizontal and vertical directions. To analyze its effectiveness, the proposed technique, LBP, and LTrP are compared. Our extensive simulation on Corel database shows that the proposed technique has better time complexity compared to these methods.

articleTitle: Clone Detection in Model-Based Development Using Formal Methods to Enhance Performance in Software Development
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Clone detection is gaining more attention due to its advantages of software maintenance. Clone detection helps in code optimization (code present in multiple locations can be updated and optimized once), bug detection (discovering bugs that are copied to multiple locations in the code), and analysis of re-used code in software systems. Importantly, model-based software development is gaining more popularity due to its reduced production time and cost. There are several approaches to detect clones in the code level, but few methods to detect clones at the model level. These methods use syntactic based analysis of models to detect clones at the model level. In this paper, we present a novel approach to detect clones at model-based levels using semantic based analysis. Our method is based on model checking which involves mathematical based analysis. Our method is tested with control flow based models and yields good results in detection of model clones.

articleTitle: Wireless NoC-A Revolutionary Alternative as Interconnection Fabric
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The recent System-on-Chip (SoC) technology is capable of integrating large number of processor cores on a single chip. As technology advances, the Network-on-Chip (NoC) architectures are emerging as one of the most promising and developing platform for the integration of such multiple embedded cores on a single die. It has been always a challenge of constructing an interconnection fabric for connecting cores and other components with efficient transport of data in minimal time, high volume, and least energy. The traditional bus based architectures suffer from many problems as the scaling of CMOS technology goes below 90nm. Looking at all possible solution for meeting the current requirements of low-power and high-speed with continuous scaling, the on-chip wireless interconnection network is viewed as a revolutionary method. Wireless network is capable of drawing significant performance gains with its implementation on chip as interconnection fabric. In this paper, it is attempted to accumulate a brief review of different interconnect strategies advancing in different domains but a special emphasis is given on wireless interconnects in NoCs. The details of topologies, modulation techniques and the tools used for realizing the wireless network on chip are also cited here.

articleTitle: Multisensory Learning Approach to Create a Sentence Learning Platformfor Students with Autism Spectrum Disorder
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Autism students has difficulties in understanding written language. They are unable to visualize a correct image in their mind by reading a sentence so they tend take more time to understand a concept from a written text. Teachers and parents has to spend more time supporting children with autism to understand the text sentence. Psychologist and researchers observed that the Autistic students grab concepts in image and sound formats more than the concepts from text sentence. The researchers have come up with some learning techniques, among these techniques Multisensory learning technique is more advanced because it contains both visual and auditory representations. There are systems which converts text sentence into 3d scene which benefits only for the visual learners in Autistic students. Identify the issues in existing text to 3d scene systems and include auditory output to create multisensory learning style approach leads to a sophisticated learning platform which helpful for both visual and auditory learners in students with Autism spectrum disorder to understand the text sentence.

articleTitle: Smart Shelve Management System Using IOT-A Novel Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Kitchen plays a vital role in cooking the food. Food is basically a necessary need of human being in its day to day activities. A lot of food items are placed in a kitchen rack under different shelves. There are various problems encountered by the person which has the responsibility of cooking. The main problem is that the food items which are required for cooking need to be checked on a daily basis by the person. The person has to check the quantities of the items regularly and have to place the order accordingly to the food store. This situation consumes more time and adds an overhead of checking food items on regular basis. We have developed a novel lOT based smart Infrastructure Management System which handles all the above problems. This system will save a not only save a lot of time of the user but also provide a smart way for placing an order.

articleTitle: Distributed Generation Placement Based on System Reliability in Unbalanced Distribution System with Uncertainty in Load Demand
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This work determines the optimal position of Distributed Generation (DG) to be installed based on the reliability in unbalanced radial distribution system with lateral branches. The loads at different load points are considered to be varying probabilistically obeying Gaussian distribution. IEEE 34 nodes unbalanced system has been considered here and optimal position has been obtained giving priority to some important performance indices, normally considered in reliability studies.

articleTitle: Novel Answer Ranking Approach in Question Answering System Using Compositional Distributional Semantic Model
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A question answering (QA) system provides direct answers to user questions by consulting its knowledge base. In recent decade, there is an explosion in the freely available information, improvements in information technology and the increase in people's desire for the better information access. One question arises related to information “meaning” while giving the exact answer of the question instead of the large document freely available information, which has created the emergence of a wide variety of computational models for modeling the meaning of words based on the underlying assumption of the distributional hypothesis, that the meaning of word can be inferred from its use. This paper explores the role of distributional semantic models (DSM) in Question Answering (QA) system. The idea is to compute the relatedness between the user question and the candidate answer retrieved by the search module. One of the shortcomings of DSMs found while applying for larger linguistic unit is “bag-of-words” limitation.

articleTitle: DWT-IDWT Based Barcode Modulation Method for Verification
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: There are several wireless data transmission techniques in which barcodes are of great relevance. In this new approach 2D barcode is forward and its enactment may be contrasted with different standard systems. For analysis purpose, the low-pass trademark of a camera phone channel and has been exhibited for encouraging wireless optical communication with versatile handheld mobile telephones. In this method, orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation is utilized together with differential phase shift (DPSK) through contiguous frequency dominion components. Proposed method aims furthermore to create an arrangement that is accepting camera activities in different variations, image fuzziness along with light spillage inside neighboring pixels of an LCD.

articleTitle: Migration and Cooling Aware Approach for Virtual Machine Spreading in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Server virtualization is a way to utilize efficient resources of the data center. One of the challenges faced by data centers is to decide when, how and which Virtual Machine to migrate. In principle, VMs will migrate from one physical host to a different host without inflicting a significant impact on the application running within them. VM selection decision opens up a huge area for researchers. VM migration cost plays a very important role in the VM selection because it directly depends upon VM performance. R. Ayoub et al. have proposed GentelCool algorithm. The proposed a policy based on GentelCool algorithm which includes VM migration cost. The proposed policy for VM Level spreading considers the migration cost and cooling cost. From the simulation results of existing and proposed VM Level spreading policy conclude that proposed VM level spreading policy provides a higher lead to terms of SLATAH, PDM and SLAV. The improvement in SLTAH is because of swapping of hot VM with colder VM, whereas the improvement in PDM is because of consideration of migration cost with cooling cost.

articleTitle: Microstrip Circular Patch Antenna with Partial Ground Structurefor X-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Amicrostrip antenna with circular patch and partial ground structure for the X-band applications is presented in this paper. The return loss of -22.32 dB is obtained at 10 GHz frequency with a wide bandwidth of 4.61 GHz ranging from 6.83 GHz to 11.44 GHz. This antenna is made to work at resonance frequency of 10 GHz. The radiating circular patch is printed on 1.6 mm thick FR4 substrate. Simulation of proposed antenna is done using Ansoft HFSS software.

articleTitle: Application Dependent Testing of FPGA Interconnect Using Satisfiability Modulo Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents an application dependent testing technique to generate test configurations for SRAM-based FPGA interconnects using Satisfiability Modulo Theory (SMT). The logic block configurations have been configured for generating test patterns for the interconnects. The proposed technique applies Walsh codes to activate faults in the nets. The interconnect is tested for stuck-at, open and bridging faults. Experimental results show that, for ISCAS89 benchmark circuits, the proposed approach can obtain minimum number of test configurations with 100 % coverage for the above mentioned faults.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Pipelined 8×8 2-D DCT and IDCT Structure for H.264 Protocol
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) is the most widely used technique for image/video compression standards. In this paper, an FPGA based 8×8 forward Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) and inverse Discrete Cosine Transform (IDCT) architectures are implemented for H.264 encoder and decoder respectively. It has been implemented using the pipelined structure for computing the Integer DCT and IDCT. The design is implemented without using any multiplication operation to reduce the complexity. H.264 is one of the recent video compression standards of the ITU-T Moving Picture Experts Group and Video Coding Experts Group. A pipelined architecture is used in this design to increase the speed of operation. The proposed resource effective architectures have been implemented and synthesized on xc2vp30 device that belongs to Vertex-2 Pro family. For Integer DCT architecture implementation, the resource utilization is 14% slices, 1% flip-flops, 11% LUTs, 51% 10Bs of xc2vp30 device and reaches an operating frequency of 520.996 MHz. For Integer IDCT architecture implementation, the resource utilization is 28% slices, 2% flip-flops, 24% LUTs, 37% 10Bs of xc2vp30 device and reaches an operating frequency of 525.22 MHz. In these designs, it takes only 49 clock cycles to generate the transformed outputs thus increasing the speed of operation.

articleTitle: Broadband Printed Hexagonal Monopole Antenna with Optimized Offset Feed and Horizontal Slot to Reduce the Lower Edge Frequency
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: An optimized design of offset fed Printed Hexagonal Monopole Antenna has been proposed to yield broad band impedance bandwidth. The simple offset printed hexagonal monopole antenna has been observed to yield VSWR ≤ 2 for the range of 744 MHz to 4.5GHz. In the present design, with 43mm×3mm wide horizontal slot at λ/16 of existing offset fed printed hexagonal monopole antenna is proposed which yields a decrement in lower edge frequency (fL).Various slots have been studied to see the effect of slot over lower edge frequency. Experiments have been carried out which are in good agreement with the simulated results.

articleTitle: Autonomous Electric Vehicle Using Ultrasonic Sensor Skirt Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The proposed work deals with the designing of a self-driven electric car used to provide automatic shuttle services within an industrial site or even college campus. In this paper, a system is designed to be used within college premises for various multi-disciplinary activities. The vehicle can move around without any manual guidance. The major task in the designing of an autonomous vehicle is to provide it with vision so that it can move around in the environment with ease. The proposed idea uses various electronic sensors to accomplish this task. It is capable of taking decisions which include avoiding of static or dynamic obstacles in between the travel path. Based on these decisions, the further movement of the vehicle is decided. The decision-making ability lies with the logic and controller system of the vehicle. The system also performs the function of detection of side walls to follow a straight path. The vehicle will decide the path based on the user defined destination point. The travel path is mapped using GPS system. The proposed system uses battery power which can be charged using solar energy via solar panels. This work gives a complete description about the system design of an autonomous electrically driven vehicle having a capacity of carrying 4 persons.
